<script data-origin="js/render/ash_frontier_environment.js">
'use strict';
/* Gray Crown Phase 8 — ash road and Serad materials, presentation ONLY.
 * Canvas integer-pixel primitives; never mutates maps, saves, events,
 * collision, story flags, scripts or locked original character PNGs.
 * No new kingdom rank crests, religion, culture or definitive weapon art.
 */
const AshFrontierEnvironment=(()=>{
 const targets=new Set(['ashroad','frontier','frontierfield']);
 const TILE_PX=32;
 const pix=(ctx,c,x,y,w,h)=>{
  ctx.fillStyle=c;ctx.fillRect(Math.round(x),Math.round(y),Math.round(w),Math.round(h));
 };
 const hash=(x,y,seed=1)=>{
  let h=(Math.imul(x+19,73856093)^Math.imul(y+103,19349663)^Math.imul(seed+7,83492791))>>>0;
  return Math.imul(h^(h>>>13),1274126177)>>>0;
 };
 const inScope=m=>api.enabled&&targets.has(m);
 // Physical poles and supply sacks are drawn ONLY on existing blocked
 // tiles (T / H); flat track marks on passable D/B/M are not obstacles.
 const blockedDecorationCells=Object.freeze({
  ashroad:Object.freeze([[0,3],[23,3],[0,10],[23,11],[0,9],[23,9]]),
  frontier:Object.freeze([[3,9],[5,9],[3,10]])
 });
 const palette=Object.freeze({
  ashroad:Object.freeze({ground:'#76695a',ash:'#625b54',path:'#a19077',edge:'#393934',dirt:'#817361'}),
  frontier:Object.freeze({ground:'#61635d',mud:'#666258',path:'#928977',edge:'#3d4041',canvas:'#999081'}),
  frontierfield:Object.freeze({ground:'#676157',mud:'#746352',path:'#998677',edge:'#414341',debris:'#54493f'})
 });
 function paintTile(ctx,map,ch,x,y){
  if(!inScope(map))return false;
  const a=x*TILE_PX,b=y*TILE_PX,r=hash(x,y),p=palette[map];
  // Broad material clusters and sparse micro-details avoid a stamped 32px
  // checkerboard. Every logical cell is nevertheless still 32px collision.
  const area=hash(Math.floor(x/3),Math.floor(y/2),11);
  if(ch==='D'){
   // Full-bleed earth: an inset 30x30 fill would draw false grid joints.
   pix(ctx,map==='ashroad'?(area%3===0?'#ae9677':'#b39a7a'):
                (area%3===0?'#a19886':'#aaa08a'),a,b,32,32);
   if((r&3)===0)pix(ctx,p.edge,a+((r>>>7)%20)+3,b+((r>>>3)%21)+4,5,1);
   if((r&7)<=2)pix(ctx,p.mud||p.ash||p.dirt,a+(r%20)+2,b+((r>>>9)%21)+4,7,1);
   return true;
  }
  if(map==='ashroad'&&(ch==='B'||ch==='T')){
   const burnt=ch==='T';
   pix(ctx,burnt?(area%3===0?'#41423b':p.edge):
       (area%4===0?'#70665a':p.ground),a,b,32,32);
   // Ash wisps remain a surface stain. Physical charred posts are drawn
   // separately and only on existing non-traversable T cells.
   if(r%4===0)pix(ctx,burnt?'#656158':'#817568',a+((r>>>5)%19)+3,b+((r>>>10)%22)+4,9,2);
   if(r%7===0)pix(ctx,'#8b7966',a+((r>>>11)%21)+3,b+((r>>>16)%24)+3,4,1);
   return true;
  }
  if((map==='frontier'||map==='frontierfield')&&['M','B','K','H'].includes(ch)){
   const wall=ch==='K'||ch==='H';
   pix(ctx,wall?(area%3===0?'#484a47':p.edge):
       (area%3===0?'#706b60':p.ground),a,b,32,32);
   // Retain rough, readable defensive masonry, but no 28x24 inset
   // rectangle on every square and no regular grid of false floor seams.
   if(wall){
    if((r&1)===0)pix(ctx,'#77766c',a+((r>>>4)%17)+5,b+((r>>>12)%20)+4,9,2);
    if((r&7)===1)pix(ctx,'#aaa395',a+((r>>>10)%19)+4,b+21,6,2);
   }else{
    if((r&3)===0)pix(ctx,p.mud,a+((r>>>3)%19)+4,b+((r>>>7)%19)+4,10,2);
    if((r&7)===2)pix(ctx,'#978470',a+((r>>>13)%23)+3,b+((r>>>17)%23)+3,5,1);
   }
   return true;
  }
  return false;
 }
 function accents(ctx,map){
  if(!inScope(map))return false;
  if(map==='ashroad'){
   // Blackened fields are still fields, not random combat furniture.
   for(const [x,y] of [[0,3],[23,3],[0,10],[23,11]]){
    pix(ctx,'#3e3c34',x*32+4,y*32+19,23,3);
    pix(ctx,'#514738',x*32+12,y*32+6,4,16);
    pix(ctx,'#827364',x*32+16,y*32+11,2,3);
   }
   // Fading wagon ruts indicate the original center north-south route.
   for(const y of [2,4,6,8,10,12]){
    for(const off of [-8,8])pix(ctx,'#776755',11*32+16+off,y*32+6,2,18);
   }
   // Neutral bundles by the eastern refugee/priest route; no path blocking.
   for(const [x,y] of [[0,9],[23,9]]){
    pix(ctx,'#594a3d',x*32+5,y*32+24,21,3);
    pix(ctx,'#aa9580',x*32+8,y*32+18,15,6);
   }
  }
  if(map==='frontier'){
   // Supply/triage lines: spatially separated without inventing military insignia.
   for(const [x,y] of [[3,9],[5,9],[3,10]]){
    pix(ctx,'#4c4437',x*32+4,y*32+23,24,4);
    pix(ctx,'#b9b09f',x*32+6,y*32+16,20,7);
    pix(ctx,'#756c59',x*32+6,y*32+19,20,2);
   }
   for(const [x,y] of [[7,7],[14,7],[7,11]]){
    pix(ctx,'#524a40',x*32+2,y*32+26,28,3);
    pix(ctx,'#867a65',x*32+2,y*32+23,28,3);
   }
  }
  if(map==='frontierfield'){
   for(const [x,y] of [[6,4],[9,8],[15,10],[19,7]]){
    pix(ctx,'#453f38',x*32+9,y*32+22,16,3);
    pix(ctx,'#887867',x*32+11,y*32+18,6,4);
   }
   // Two kinds of torn neutral fabric tell the retreat story, no official standards.
   for(const [x,y,c] of [[6,7,'#86676b'],[18,8,'#697885']]){
    pix(ctx,'#5a5249',x*32+14,y*32+14,2,12);pix(ctx,c,x*32+16,y*32+14,10,4);
   }
  }
  return true
 }
 function objectAccent(ctx,map,o){
  if(!inScope(map)||!o)return false;
  const x=o.x*32,y=o.y*32;
  if(map==='ashroad'&&o.id==='burnedCart'){
   pix(ctx,'#38342f',x+3,y+23,26,3);
   pix(ctx,'#7b6150',x+6,y+17,20,4);
  }else if(map==='ashroad'&&o.id==='scorchedOrders'){
   pix(ctx,'#4c443b',x+8,y+27,17,2);
  }else if(map==='frontier'&&o.id==='fieldHospital'){
   pix(ctx,'#b6a98e',x+3,y+24,26,3);
   pix(ctx,'#5a6259',x+5,y+20,22,4);
  }else if(map==='frontier'&&o.id==='frontierCache'){
   pix(ctx,'#625742',x+4,y+25,24,3);
  }else if(map==='frontierfield'&&o.id==='stretcherTracks'){
   pix(ctx,'#786754',x+7,y+29,19,1);
  }else return false;
  return true
 }
 function npcAccent(ctx,map,n){
  if(!inScope(map)||!n)return false;
  const id=n.id,cx=n.x*32+16,y=n.y*32+30;
  const ui=(p,q,w,h,color)=>pix(ctx,color,cx+p,y+q,w,h);
  if(id==='refugee'){ui(-9,-7,18,6,'#766259');ui(3,-18,6,8,'#d6b894')}
  else if(id==='fieldPriest'){ // Unmarked relief apron, no formal religious sign.
   ui(-10,-10,20,12,'#c6bca9');ui(-6,-6,12,3,'#776b5f')}
  else if(id==='frontierOfficer'){ui(-11,-15,22,3,'#62534e');ui(-7,-5,14,2,'#a99672')}
  else if(id==='frontierMedic'){ui(-9,-9,18,10,'#9eaa9c');ui(-11,-6,4,7,'#d7c4a6')}
  else if(id==='kingdomGuard'||id==='imperialGuard'){ui(-10,-13,20,4,'#5b5d62');ui(-7,-13,14,2,'#adaca1')}
  else if(id==='frontierScout'){ui(-11,-15,22,3,'#7c7263');ui(-5,-4,10,2,'#b69c7b')}
  else if(id==='woundedImperial'){ui(-10,-6,20,6,'#7b7069');ui(3,-10,8,5,'#bca9a2')}
  else return false;
  return true
 }
 const api={enabled:true,targets,palette,blockedDecorationCells,paintTile,accents,objectAccent,npcAccent};
 return api
})();

</script>
<script data-origin="js/render/opening_pixel_assets.js">
'use strict';
/*
 * Opening pixel-native source atlas. Runtime generated, not stock imagery or
 * shifted screenshots. Each named resident has an individual authored profile;
 * four direction rows x four independently articulated leg/arm frames.
 * Houses have separate 104x108 offscreen tile compositions cached by name.
 */
const OpeningPixelAssets=(()=>{
 const designs={
  fieldWorker:['#796349','#73875a','#d6af8f','farmer','hat'],
  brookKeeper:['#606354','#718a7d','#d8b796','civil','short'],
  father:['#3f3840','#5f7185','#bda48f','fighter','short'],
  orphan:['#a88665','#9a8f70','#d6b799','child','bob'],
  mayor:['#b3a5a2','#556779','#d4af93','elder','part'],
  messenger:['#65574b','#912f39','#d3ac8c','courier','part'],
  mika:['#98715c','#c2a08a','#e4b894','child','twin'],
  ren:['#483a36','#6c8a73','#d6b18c','child','short'],
  lulu:['#bd9a70','#ae7790','#e0b48e','child','bob'],
  baker:['#765547','#ead9bc','#d9aa81','baker','bun'],
  farmer:['#a89262','#6f8561','#cfa382','farmer','hat'],
  oldwoman:['#c5c2b3','#80706e','#d7b397','elder','bun'],
  veteran:['#55515a','#657080','#c3a18f','fighter','scar'],
  karenMother:['#8b5b4d','#bd9779','#dab79b','civil','bun'],
  karenFather:['#42362f','#79694a','#d8ad8c','civil','short'],
  karenBrother:['#96644c','#6a8373','#ddb08d','child','messy'],
  caretaker:['#a29680','#7d957f','#dfbea0','caretaker','bun'],
  theo:['#c5a879','#89a0a0','#e0b994','child','short'],
  noa:['#775144','#a389ae','#d9b08c','child','bob'],
  emi:['#a88964','#c99e7f','#e0b38e','child','twin'],
  margaretMother:['#c8b6ca','#7c6b93','#d4aa93','civil','long'],
  clerk:['#766e5e','#65817e','#d1ab8c','scribe','short'],
  soldierMother:['#6f584d','#827f83','#d1a889','civil','bun'],
  soldierSister:['#74564e','#9b7d87','#d8ad93','child','long'],
  merchant:['#a08363','#796b55','#d2a486','merchant','hat'],
  scout:['#5d493c','#698276','#cfa88a','fighter','hood'],
  capitalOfficial:['#5b5256','#696b85','#d7b393','scribe','part'],
  capitalCitizen:['#875f4f','#748b91','#dcb596','civil','part'],
  capitalFlowerGirl:['#ba8b65','#b57384','#e3b797','florist','twin'],
  capitalRecruit:['#67564a','#596b8e','#d7ab90','fighter','short'],
  capitalVendor:['#715241','#ab8a65','#dcac88','merchant','bun'],
  rationMother:['#756b63','#7a8077','#d4ab94','caretaker','scarf'],
  granz:['#474954','#596376','#c49f85','fighter','part'],
  capitalInnHost:['#865e48','#9b7f5f','#d9b596','baker','bun'],
  offDutySoldier:['#423f48','#6e748b','#c9a48d','fighter','short'],
  capitalSmith:['#5e4440','#776760','#d3a787','smith','short'],
  armoryApprentice:['#947560','#7b8392','#d8ae8d','smith','messy']
 };
 // Explicit role + silhouette grammar, not one shared body with palette swaps.
 // Each named resident uses a physical shape and practical object relevant to
 // their work/family. Shapes remain inside a 32px cell; no collision changes.
 const identities=Object.freeze({
  father:'trainer',orphan:'child',mayor:'elderOffice',messenger:'courier',
  mika:'ribbonChild',ren:'practiceChild',lulu:'ribbonChild',baker:'baker',
  farmer:'farmer',oldwoman:'elderShawl',veteran:'veteran',
  karenMother:'homeApron',karenFather:'homeWork',karenBrother:'homeChild',
  caretaker:'care',theo:'satchelChild',noa:'ribbonChild',emi:'ribbonChild',
  margaretMother:'homeBooks',clerk:'ledger',soldierMother:'homeWork',
  soldierSister:'homeChild',merchant:'travelMerchant',scout:'scout',
  fieldWorker:'farmer',brookKeeper:'waterside',
  capitalOfficial:'cityOfficial',capitalCitizen:'cityResident',
  capitalFlowerGirl:'florist',capitalRecruit:'recruit',
  capitalVendor:'cityMerchant',rationMother:'queueFamily',granz:'commander',
  capitalInnHost:'innkeeper',offDutySoldier:'offDuty',
  capitalSmith:'smith',armoryApprentice:'smithApprentice'
 });
 function signature(c,id,dir,frame,coat,skin){
  const type=identities[id];if(!type)return;
  const light=tint(coat,32),dark=tint(coat,-36);
  const front=dir===0,side=dir===1||dir===2,back=dir===3;
  const pulse=(frame===1?-1:frame===3?1:0);
  // Clothing silhouettes are drawn before face details and stay grounded.
  switch(type){
   case 'trainer': case 'veteran': case 'scout':
    P(c,dark,5,17,4,13);P(c,dark,23,17,4,13);
    P(c,'#a18b65',8,21,16,3);
    if(type==='trainer')P(c,'#b4b1a2',26,9,2,18);
    if(type==='veteran')P(c,'#a6a292',6,16,4,3);
    if(type==='scout')P(c,'#5b604f',5,11,5,13);
    break;
   case 'baker':case 'innkeeper':case 'homeApron':case 'care':
    P(c,'#dfd0ac',10,18,13,12);P(c,'#998467',11,28,10,2);
    P(c,'#c3ad8e',11,21,3,7);
    if(type==='care')P(c,'#8a9078',19,23,4,4);
    if(type==='baker')P(c,'#77583a',24,18+pulse,6,4);
    if(type==='innkeeper')P(c,'#b8a077',24,19+pulse,5,3);
    break;
   case 'farmer':case 'waterside':
    P(c,'#646249',8,15,4,16);P(c,'#9a946d',21,15,3,13);
    P(c,'#5b5b44',12,25,9,4);
    if(type==='farmer')P(c,'#ab8d60',25,9,2,19);
    else P(c,'#c1b49a',25,17,5,3);
    break;
   case 'child':case 'ribbonChild':case 'practiceChild':case 'homeChild':case 'satchelChild':
    // Small children have an actual flared lower garment / sash, not mini-adult boots.
    P(c,light,11,25,10,4);
    if(type==='practiceChild')P(c,'#a89a75',25,16,2,12);
    if(type==='satchelChild'){P(c,'#786653',7,16,3,9);P(c,'#c5ae86',6,23,6,5)}
    if(type==='homeChild')P(c,'#d4a97a',22,21,4,4);
    break;
   case 'elderOffice':case 'elderShawl':case 'ledger':case 'homeBooks':
    P(c,dark,8,23,16,7);
    P(c,'#bcb6a6',8,16,16,4);
    if(type==='elderShawl'){P(c,'#847478',5,13,8,12);P(c,'#9e8b71',27,16,2,15)}
    else {P(c,'#c1a477',24,20,6,5);P(c,'#725c48',25,22,4,1)}
    break;
   case 'courier':case 'cityOfficial':case 'commander':
    P(c,dark,5,16,5,14);P(c,dark,22,16,5,14);
    P(c,'#c7b083',10,19,13,3);
    if(type==='commander'){P(c,'#b1a28a',6,15,7,3);P(c,'#b1a28a',19,15,7,3)}
    else P(c,'#e0ccaa',23,21+pulse,6,5);
    break;
   case 'homeWork':case 'queueFamily':case 'offDuty':case 'cityResident':
    P(c,dark,7,21,4,10);P(c,light,21,23,4,7);
    if(type==='queueFamily')P(c,'#aaa28f',5,12,7,10);
    if(type==='offDuty')P(c,'#9da3a4',10,21,12,2);
    break;
   case 'travelMerchant':case 'cityMerchant':
    P(c,'#8a6c4c',5,20+pulse,7,10);
    P(c,'#c4a578',6,21+pulse,5,3);
    P(c,light,22,17,4,12);
    if(type==='cityMerchant')P(c,'#c9b18b',11,19,10,9);
    break;
   case 'recruit':
    P(c,'#acb2ad',8,17,16,4);P(c,dark,8,25,16,4);
    P(c,'#b8ad8c',14,18,3,10);break;
   case 'florist':
    P(c,'#b87e86',10,19,13,10);P(c,'#755b42',25,22+pulse,6,7);
    P(c,'#b96874',26,17+pulse,4,5);break;
   case 'smith':case 'smithApprentice':
    P(c,'#665d58',9,17,16,13);P(c,'#ad9376',12,20,10,8);
    P(c,'#b1b8b8',25,17+pulse,3,8);
    if(type==='smithApprentice')P(c,'#8c9caa',7,18,4,9);
    break;
  }
  // Identity marks on the face/head are drawn only after the main face.
  if((type==='ribbonChild'||type==='homeBooks')&&!back){
   P(c,'#d5bc98',25,7,4,3);
   if(type==='ribbonChild')P(c,'#ad7385',26,7,3,2);
  }
  if(type==='elderShawl'&&front)P(c,'#e0c9ae',14,12,4,1);
  if(type==='cityOfficial'&&front)P(c,'#d5c59f',14,17,4,2);
  if(type==='scout'&&side)P(c,'#8a866d',26,13,2,8);
 }

 // Nine bespoke resident silhouettes with four separately drawn directions.
 // Real transparent PNG pixel source, not another tint over the shared body.
 const useLegacyArt=typeof window!=='undefined'&&/(?:^|[?&])npcArt=legacy(?:&|$)/.test(window.location.search||'');
 const featuredNames=['baker','farmer','oldwoman','mayor','messenger','ren',
  'capitalFlowerGirl','capitalRecruit','granz'];
 const featuredIndex=new Map(featuredNames.map((id,i)=>[id,i]));
 let featuredSheet=null,featuredReady=false,featuredFailed=false,featuredRequested=false;
 // Distinct hand-authored action frames: front-facing 9 residents x 2 gestures.
 // Not scaled or shifted base PNGs: expressions, limbs and tools are repainted per role.
 // Optional; a failed download always falls back to the legible resting pose.
 let actionSheet=null,actionsReady=false,actionsFailed=false,actionsRequested=false;
 function tryFeatured(c,n,dir,now=0){
  const index=featuredIndex.get(n.id);
  if(index===undefined||featuredFailed)return false;
  if(!featuredRequested){
   featuredRequested=true;
   try{
    featuredSheet=new Image();
    featuredSheet.onload=()=>{
     featuredReady=useLegacyArt?(featuredSheet.naturalWidth===288&&featuredSheet.naturalHeight===128):(featuredSheet.naturalWidth===432&&featuredSheet.naturalHeight===192);
     featuredFailed=!featuredReady;
     if(featuredFailed)GC?.Log?.warn?.('Featured residents atlas wrong dimensions');
     else GC?.Render?.World?.draw?.();
    };
    featuredSheet.onerror=()=>{featuredFailed=true;GC?.Log?.warn?.('Featured residents atlas failed to load')};
    featuredSheet.src=useLegacyArt?'assets/npc/featured_residents_v1.png':'assets/npc/featured_residents_charm_v5.png';
   }catch(e){featuredFailed=true;GC?.Log?.warn?.('Featured residents atlas unavailable',{detail:String(e)})}
  }
  if(!featuredReady)return false;
  if(!actionsRequested){
   actionsRequested=true;
   try{
    actionSheet=new Image();
    actionSheet.onload=()=>{
     actionsReady=actionSheet.naturalWidth===432&&actionSheet.naturalHeight===96;
     actionsFailed=!actionsReady;
     if(actionsReady)GC?.Render?.World?.draw?.();
     else GC?.Log?.warn?.('Resident gesture PNG has unexpected dimensions');
    };
    actionSheet.onerror=()=>{actionsFailed=true;GC?.Log?.warn?.('Resident gesture PNG unavailable')};
    actionSheet.src=useLegacyArt?'assets/npc/featured_resident_actions_v2.png':'assets/npc/featured_resident_actions_charm_v5.png';
   }catch(e){actionsFailed=true;GC?.Log?.warn?.('Resident gesture PNG blocked',{detail:String(e)})}
  }
  let pose=0;
  if(!useLegacyArt&&dir==='down'&&actionsReady&&!actionsFailed&&typeof OpeningWorldLife!=='undefined')
   pose=OpeningWorldLife.workPhase(n.id,now);
  const stage=pose!==0?pose===1?0:1:-1;
  const sheet=stage<0?featuredSheet:actionSheet;
  const srcSize=useLegacyArt?32:48;
  const sy=stage<0?(dirs[dir]??0)*srcSize:stage*48;
  // Keep the existing PNG pixels, outfit, face and poses intact.
  // The original featured NPC draw scaled to 48px and ended at tile+32,
  // while hero art appears at 44px and ends at tile+30. The 8% scale and
  // 2px footline difference made residents look pasted onto the map.
  const destSize=useLegacyArt?32:44;
  const centerX=n.x*32+16,footY=n.y*32+30;
  c.save();c.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
  if(c.beginPath&&c.ellipse&&c.fill){
   c.fillStyle='rgba(16,18,18,.25)';
   c.beginPath();c.ellipse(centerX,footY-1,useLegacyArt?8:9,3,0,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill()
  }
  c.drawImage(sheet,index*srcSize,sy,srcSize,srcSize,
   Math.round(centerX-destSize/2),useLegacyArt?n.y*32:footY-destSize,destSize,destSize);
  c.restore();return true
 }
 function featuredStatus(){return {requested:featuredRequested,ready:featuredReady,
  failed:featuredFailed,count:featuredNames.length,
  gesturesRequested:actionsRequested,gesturesReady:actionsReady,gesturesFailed:actionsFailed,
  artVersion:useLegacyArt?'classic-v1':'concept-charm-v5'}}
 const dirs={down:0,left:1,right:2,up:3};
 const npcCache=new Map(),houseCache=new Map();
 const P=(c,color,x,y,w,h)=>{c.fillStyle=color;c.fillRect(x|0,y|0,w|0,h|0)};
 function canvas(w,h){
  if(typeof document==='undefined'||!document.createElement)return null;
  const el=document.createElement('canvas');if(typeof el.getContext!=='function')return null;el.width=w;el.height=h;
  return el
 }
 function part(c,col,x,y,w,h){
  P(c,'#352d32',x-1,y-1,w+2,h+2);P(c,col,x,y,w,h)
 }
 // All pixels drawn in logical 32x32 cell coordinates.
 function tint(color,amount){
  const n=parseInt(color.slice(1),16),f=x=>Math.min(255,Math.max(0,(x+amount)|0));
  return '#'+[f(n>>16),f((n>>8)&255),f(n&255)].map(v=>v.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('')
 }
 // A person's face should convey their social role before a dialogue label
 // appears. Every currently authored fallback resident has an intentional
 // resting emotion instead of a random eye/mouth formula from their ID hash.
 const expressions=Object.freeze({
  fieldWorker:'weary',brookKeeper:'focused',father:'guarded',
  orphan:'bright',mayor:'focused',messenger:'guarded',mika:'bright',
  ren:'bright',lulu:'gentle',baker:'gentle',farmer:'weary',
  oldwoman:'gentle',veteran:'guarded',karenMother:'gentle',
  karenFather:'focused',karenBrother:'bright',caretaker:'gentle',
  theo:'curious',noa:'shy',emi:'bright',margaretMother:'curious',
  clerk:'focused',soldierMother:'weary',soldierSister:'shy',
  merchant:'curious',scout:'guarded',capitalOfficial:'guarded',
  capitalCitizen:'gentle',capitalFlowerGirl:'bright',capitalRecruit:'shy',
  capitalVendor:'curious',rationMother:'weary',granz:'guarded',
  capitalInnHost:'gentle',offDutySoldier:'weary',
  capitalSmith:'focused',armoryApprentice:'curious'
 });
 function person(c,profile,dir,frame,id=''){
  const [hair,coat,skin,job,style]=profile;
  const side=dir===1||dir===2,back=dir===3,child=job==='child',
   old=job==='elder',armed=job==='fighter',working=['baker','farmer','smith','florist','scribe','merchant'].includes(job);
  let seed=0;for(const letter of id)seed=(seed*33+letter.charCodeAt(0))>>>0;
  const variation=seed%4,mood=expressions[id]||'focused',
   headW=child?14:variation===0?15:variation===1?16:14,
   headX=16-Math.floor(headW/2),headY=child?9:old?6:5;
  const bodyW=armed?16:child?10:old?15:variation===3?12:14,bodyX=16-Math.floor(bodyW/2),bodyTop=child?21:old?17:16;
  const front=dir===0,step=working?0:[0,2,0,-2][frame],
   armL=frame===1?-3:frame===3?2:0,armR=frame===1?2:frame===3?-3:0;
  const ink=tint(hair,-65),skinShadow=tint(skin,-27),coatLight=tint(coat,26),coatShade=tint(coat,-24),hairLight=tint(hair,25);
  // Back layers establish hair silhouette BEFORE the body and face.
  if(['long','twin','bob','scarf'].includes(style)){
   P(c,ink,headX-3,headY+3,headW+6,17);
   P(c,hair,headX-2,headY+4,headW+4,16);
   if(style==='long')P(c,hair,headX+headW-1,headY+12,4,13);
   if(style==='twin'){
    P(c,ink,headX-5,headY+8,5,13);P(c,hair,headX-4,headY+9,3,11);
    P(c,ink,headX+headW,headY+7,6,14);P(c,hair,headX+headW+1,headY+8,4,12);
   }
  }
  // Shoes and legs are independently posed. Idle workers stay grounded.
  const lx=11+step,rx=18-step;
  P(c,'#2e3037',lx-1,24,6,7);P(c,'#2e3037',rx-1,24,6,7);
  P(c,coatShade,lx,24,4,4);P(c,coatShade,rx,24,4,4);
  P(c,'#68584d',lx-1,29,6,2);P(c,'#68584d',rx-1,29,6,2);
  // Outfit silhouette differs between child, healer, warrior and trades.
  P(c,'#2f353c',bodyX-1,bodyTop-1,bodyW+2,12);
  P(c,coat,bodyX,bodyTop,bodyW,10);
  P(c,coatLight,bodyX+1,bodyTop+1,2,7);
  P(c,coatShade,bodyX+bodyW-3,bodyTop+1,2,8);
  if(old){P(c,coat,bodyX-1,bodyTop+8,bodyW+2,5);P(c,coatShade,bodyX,bodyTop+10,bodyW,2)}
  if(child){P(c,coat,bodyX+1,bodyTop+7,bodyW-2,4)}
  if(armed){P(c,'#aeb2ac',bodyX,bodyTop+3,bodyW,3);P(c,coatShade,bodyX+bodyW/2-1,bodyTop+3,3,9)}
  if(job==='baker'||job==='caretaker'||job==='smith'){
   P(c,'#ead9b7',13,bodyTop+3,7,8);P(c,'#b7a78c',13,bodyTop+9,7,2);
  }else if(job==='merchant'||job==='courier'){P(c,'#c5a46c',bodyX+3,bodyTop+1,3,10)}
  else if(job==='scribe'){P(c,'#d5c5a4',bodyX+1,bodyTop+1,bodyW-2,2)}
  else if(job==='florist'){P(c,'#cf8b9b',bodyX+2,bodyTop+4,bodyW-4,4)}
  else if(variation===1){P(c,'#d1c0a0',bodyX+2,bodyTop+5,bodyW-4,2)}
  else if(variation===2){P(c,coatLight,bodyX+bodyW-4,bodyTop+2,3,7)}
  // Forearms have two distinct drawn joints per work frame.
  const lw=armed?5:4,lh=old?7:9,shoulder=bodyW/2+2;
  part(c,coat,16-shoulder-lw,bodyTop+2+armL,lw,lh);
  part(c,coat,16+shoulder,bodyTop+2+armR,lw,lh);
  P(c,skinShadow,16-shoulder-lw+1,bodyTop+lh+armL,3,3);
  P(c,skin,16+shoulder+1,bodyTop+lh+armR,3,3);
  // Face with deliberate cheek contour instead of identical rectangle heads.
  P(c,ink,headX-2,headY-2,headW+4,14);
  P(c,hair,headX-1,headY-1,headW+2,12);
  if(style==='messy'){
   P(c,ink,headX-3,headY-2,5,4);P(c,hair,headX-2,headY-3,4,4);
   P(c,hairLight,headX+headW-2,headY-3,4,3);
  }
  if(style==='bun'){
   P(c,ink,headX+headW-2,headY-5,7,8);
   P(c,hair,headX+headW-1,headY-4,5,6);
  }
  if(style==='part'){P(c,hairLight,headX+2,headY-1,headW-5,2)}
  if(style==='scarf'||style==='hood'){
   P(c,coatShade,headX-3,headY,4,14);
   P(c,coatShade,headX+headW-1,headY,4,14);
  }
  P(c,back?hair:skinShadow,headX,headY+3,headW,11);
  if(!back){
   P(c,skin,headX+1,headY+3,headW-2,9);
   P(c,skinShadow,headX+2,headY+11,headW-4,1);
   // Taper the cheeks into a rounded lower jaw instead of a flat box.
   P(c,skin,headX+3,headY+11,headW-6,2);
  }
  if(side){
   P(c,hair,dir===1?headX+headW-3:headX,headY+4,3,9);
   P(c,'#4d3839',dir===1?headX+3:headX+headW-5,headY+8,2,2);
   P(c,'#ffefe0',dir===1?headX+3:headX+headW-5,headY+8,1,1);
   P(c,skinShadow,dir===1?headX:headX+headW-1,headY+9,2,2);
  }else if(front){
   const eyeColor=mood==='bright'?'#3f3541':mood==='weary'?'#625451':'#483c3b';
   const leftEye=headX+3,rightEye=headX+headW-5;
   const eyeH=['bright','curious'].includes(mood)?3:mood==='focused'?1:2;
   P(c,eyeColor,leftEye,headY+8,2,eyeH);
   P(c,eyeColor,rightEye,headY+8,2,eyeH);
   if(['bright','curious','gentle'].includes(mood)){
    P(c,'#fff2e2',leftEye,headY+8,1,1);P(c,'#fff2e2',rightEye,headY+8,1,1);
   }
   // Eyebrows are intentional acting: worried, curious and guarded faces
   // have genuinely different strokes at the scale the player sees.
   if(mood==='guarded'){
    P(c,ink,leftEye-1,headY+6,3,1);
    P(c,ink,rightEye,headY+7,3,1)
   }else if(mood==='weary'){
    P(c,skinShadow,leftEye-1,headY+7,3,1);
    P(c,skinShadow,rightEye,headY+6,3,1)
   }else if(mood==='curious'){
    P(c,hairLight,leftEye-1,headY+5,3,1);
    P(c,hairLight,rightEye,headY+6,3,1)
   }else if(mood==='shy'){
    P(c,skinShadow,leftEye,headY+7,3,1);
    P(c,skinShadow,rightEye,headY+7,3,1)
   }
   if(old||mood==='weary'){
    P(c,skinShadow,leftEye-1,headY+10,2,1);
    P(c,skinShadow,rightEye+1,headY+10,2,1)
   }else{
    P(c,'#d18d8e',headX+1,headY+10,2,1);
    P(c,'#d18d8e',headX+headW-3,headY+10,2,1)
   }
   const mouth=headX+Math.floor(headW/2)-1;
   const lip=['bright','gentle'].includes(mood)?'#a75e69':'#8f615a';
   P(c,lip,mouth,headY+12,mood==='bright'?4:3,1);
   if(['bright','gentle'].includes(mood)){
    P(c,'#ffd4bc',mouth+1,headY+13,2,1);
    P(c,lip,mouth-1,headY+11,1,1);
   }else if(mood==='weary'){
    P(c,skinShadow,mouth+1,headY+13,2,1);
   }else if(mood==='shy'){
    P(c,'#c9828a',headX+2,headY+10,2,1);
   }
  }
  // Hair is the main identifier; pupils and brows never override the fringe.
  if(style==='bob'||style==='long'||style==='scarf'){P(c,hair,headX-2,headY+4,3,8);P(c,hair,headX+headW-1,headY+4,3,8)}
  if(style==='short'){P(c,hair,headX,headY+3,headW,3);P(c,hairLight,headX+1,headY+2,Math.max(3,headW-6),1)}
  if(style==='twin'){P(c,hair,headX,headY+2,headW,4);P(c,hairLight,headX+2,headY+2,Math.max(3,headW-8),1)}
  if(style==='hat'){
   P(c,'#453f38',headX-6,headY,headW+12,3);
   P(c,'#b09a69',headX-4,headY-5,headW+8,6);
   P(c,'#e1c58e',headX-2,headY-2,headW+4,1);
  }
  if(style==='scar'&&front)P(c,'#ae7c6f',headX+headW-5,headY+6,2,4);
  // Props communicate occupations but do not cover faces.
  const held=frame===1?-1:frame===3?1:0;
  if(job==='baker'){P(c,'#6d533d',24,21+held,6,3);P(c,'#dfb579',25,18+held,5,4)}
  if(job==='farmer'){P(c,'#92744f',26,5,2,24);P(c,'#8d9870',24,4,7,3)}
  if(job==='courier'){P(c,'#ddcda7',23,19+held,6,5);P(c,'#a4775c',24,21+held,4,1)}
  if(job==='florist'){P(c,'#795b40',25,21+held,5,6);P(c,'#ca7e92',24,17+held,5,4);P(c,'#799669',26,15+held,2,5)}
  if(job==='merchant'){P(c,'#7d6348',3,20+held,6,8);P(c,'#cfb184',4,20+held,4,3)}
  if(job==='smith'){P(c,'#aab3b4',25,15+held,3,8);P(c,'#665247',23,16+held,7,4)}
  if(job==='elder'){P(c,'#968165',27,15,2,16)}
  // Reserved, hand-directed details for villagers whose generic role outlines
  // would otherwise look identical even when their palette is different.
  if(id==='lulu'){P(c,'#edd19a',headX+headW-1,headY+1,4,3);P(c,'#b96e73',headX+headW,headY,2,2)}
  if(id==='noa'){P(c,'#d8b8c2',headX-3,headY+4,3,5);P(c,'#8f7091',headX-3,headY+9,2,6)}
  if(id==='baker'){P(c,'#f1e6d0',14,bodyTop+4,4,2);P(c,'#b48b67',15,bodyTop+8,2,2)}
  if(id==='capitalInnHost'){P(c,'#e7c394',18,bodyTop+3,3,3);P(c,'#8a6054',20,bodyTop+7,4,2)}
  signature(c,id,dir,frame,coat,skin);

 }
 function makeNpc(profile,id){
  const img=canvas(128,128);if(!img)return null;
  const c=img.getContext('2d');c.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
  for(let dir=0;dir<4;dir++)for(let frame=0;frame<4;frame++){
   c.save();c.translate(frame*32,dir*32);person(c,profile,dir,frame,id);c.restore()
  }
  return img
 }
 function drawNpc(c,n,dir='down',now=0){
  if(tryFeatured(c,n,dir,now))return true;
  const profile=designs[n.id];if(!profile)return false;
  let sheet=npcCache.get(n.id);
  if(!sheet){sheet=makeNpc(profile,n.id);if(!sheet)return false;npcCache.set(n.id,sheet)}
  const near=now>0&&!((typeof matchMedia==='function')&&matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)').matches);
  // Static villagers do not march in place. Workers animate arms while
  // feet stay planted; individual moving NPCs will use walk frames later.
  const working=['baker','farmer','merchant','capitalVendor','capitalFlowerGirl',
   'capitalSmith','armoryApprentice','clerk','capitalInnHost','fieldWorker'].includes(n.id);
  // Farmhand: one measured hand/tool adjustment per long idle cycle. Feet never move.
  // Brook watcher and all non-worker residents hold a real standing pose.
  const frame=near&&working&&typeof OpeningWorldLife!=='undefined'
   ?OpeningWorldLife.workPhase(n.id,now):0;
  c.save();c.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
  // The 32px native art also needs the same unobtrusive ground contact.
  // Never recolor, repaint or paste accessories across its pixels.
  if(c.beginPath&&c.ellipse&&c.fill){
   c.fillStyle='rgba(16,18,18,.25)';
   c.beginPath();c.ellipse(n.x*32+16,n.y*32+29,8,3,0,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill()
  }
  c.drawImage(sheet,frame*32,(dirs[dir]??0)*32,32,32,n.x*32,n.y*32,32,32);
  c.restore();return true
 }
 const roofs={
  village:['#a45d4c','#dbbe94','#795a46','#b98461'],
  orphanage:['#657659','#d7c5a5','#5b6853','#a2b087'],
  mayorhouse:['#586a80','#c6bda9','#536072','#8795a5'],
  cottage:['#84654d','#cfb899','#66513c','#ad8664']
 };
 function drawHouse(c,kind,x,y){
  const k=roofs[kind];if(!k)return false;
  let tile=houseCache.get(kind);
  if(!tile){
   tile=canvas(104,108);if(!tile)return false;
   const a=tile.getContext('2d');a.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
   const [roof,wall,beam,roofHighlight]=k;
   // Layered 4-pixel roof stairs are bespoke per residence.
   P(a,'#35363a',1,40,101,60);P(a,wall,4,43,96,56);
   P(a,'#d7c8aa',6,44,92,3);
   if(kind==='orphanage'){
    // Low, broad shelter instead of a private-house gable.
    for(let z=0;z<5;z++){
     P(a,'#333f39',z*3,37-z*3,104-z*6,6);
     P(a,z%2?roofHighlight:roof,z*3+1,35-z*3,102-z*6,5)
    }
    P(a,'#52684f',6,40,92,9);
    P(a,'#a2b48a',10,42,84,3);
    for(let x of [12,88])P(a,'#65785d',x,48,4,46);
   }else if(kind==='mayorhouse'){
    // Official residence: flanking low wings and a raised center tower.
    for(let z=0;z<4;z++){
     P(a,'#435060',z*3,42-z*4,104-z*6,6);
     P(a,z%2?roofHighlight:roof,z*3+1,40-z*4,102-z*6,5)
    }
    P(a,'#53687b',30,15,44,43);
    for(let z=0;z<6;z++){
     P(a,'#3e4859',30+z*3,16-z*3,44-z*6,6);
     P(a,z%2?roof:roofHighlight,31+z*3,14-z*3,42-z*6,4)
    }
    P(a,'#9caeae',44,20,16,19);
    P(a,'#4f5d69',51,20,2,19);
   }else if(kind==='cottage'){
    // Asymmetric roof, an extension and kitchen chimney.
    P(a,'#5a473b',2,35,99,14);
    for(let z=0;z<7;z++){
     const left=z*4,right=z*8;
     P(a,'#4c3c37',left,38-z*4,102-left-right,6);
     P(a,z%2?roof:roofHighlight,left+1,36-z*4,100-left-right,5)
    }
    P(a,'#755b45',74,45,24,23);
    P(a,'#b49d7e',78,49,16,16);
   }else{
    // Classic family-home, symmetrical steep timber roof.
    for(let z=0;z<7;z++){
     const yy=34-z*4,xx=z*6;
     P(a,'#473d3a',xx,yy+4,104-xx*2,6);
     P(a,z%2?roof:roofHighlight,xx+1,yy,102-xx*2,6);
    }
   }
   P(a,beam,7,44,5,55);P(a,beam,91,44,5,55);
   const windows=kind==='orphanage'?[15,44,73]:kind==='cottage'?[18]:kind==='mayorhouse'?[15,72]:[19,69];
   for(const wx of windows){
    const ww=kind==='orphanage'?13:15;
    P(a,beam,wx-3,57,ww+6,24);
    P(a,'#87a4a0',wx,60,ww,17);
    P(a,'#d7dfc9',wx+2,61,Math.max(3,ww-9),5);
    P(a,beam,wx+Math.floor(ww/2),60,2,17);
   }
   P(a,'#554238',40,69,25,31);P(a,'#8e6b4c',43,72,19,28);P(a,'#d9b981',57,83,3,3);
   P(a,beam,7,95,90,5);
   if(kind==='orphanage'){P(a,'#6a8a64',10,48,84,9);P(a,'#d9c99c',17,49,70,3);P(a,'#8e986d',73,86,17,6);P(a,'#655946',70,92,21,3)}
   if(kind==='mayorhouse'){P(a,'#495866',30,8,44,28);P(a,'#a7b6b5',37,12,29,20);P(a,'#6c8790',49,13,3,19);P(a,'#c9c1ad',31,100,43,5)}
   if(kind==='cottage'){P(a,'#594940',73,1,15,31);P(a,'#b59a77',76,4,9,27);P(a,'#51403c',71,0,20,5);for(let j=0;j<3;j++)P(a,'#7b8d63',12+j*10,93,6,7)}
   if(kind==='village'){P(a,'#6d5541',12,14,14,23);P(a,'#ba9676',15,17,8,19);for(let j=0;j<4;j++)P(a,'#8f6a4f',73+j*6,92,6,7)}
   houseCache.set(kind,tile)
  }
  c.save();c.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;c.drawImage(tile,x,y);c.restore();return true
 }
 const api={designs,identities,featuredNames,featuredStatus,drawNpc,drawHouse,dirs,getNpcAtlas:id=>npcCache.get(id),getHouseTile:id=>houseCache.get(id)};
 return api
})();

</script>
<script data-origin="js/render/opening_worldlife.js">
'use strict';
/*
 * Authored opening world-life details: village, road, capital.
 * Decorative only: the map, tile collisions, character positions and saved
 * progress are owned by existing systems. No new invisible obstacles.
 * Deliberate landmarks are positioned against pre-existing story locations.
 */
const OpeningWorldLife=(()=>{
 const maps=new Set(['village','road','capital']);
 const R=(c,col,x,y,w,h)=>{c.fillStyle=col;c.fillRect(Math.round(x),Math.round(y),Math.round(w),Math.round(h))};
 const at=(x,y)=>[x*32,y*32];
 function basket(c,x,y,kind='full'){
  R(c,'#504230',x+1,y+8,20,8);R(c,'#a47c4d',x+3,y+7,16,7);
  R(c,'#d5b17b',x+5,y+11,12,1);R(c,'#634b36',x+3,y+8,2,6);R(c,'#634b36',x+16,y+8,2,6);
  if(kind==='full')for(const [xx,yy] of [[5,5],[11,3],[15,6]]){R(c,'#c39b5e',x+xx,y+yy,5,4);R(c,'#ebca88',x+xx+1,y+yy,2,1)}
 }
 function wheel(c,x,y){
  R(c,'#47382d',x-6,y-6,13,13);R(c,'#a0875c',x-4,y-4,9,9);R(c,'#5c4635',x-2,y-2,5,5);R(c,'#dec391',x,y,2,2)
 }
 function cart(c,x,y,condition='broken'){
  // Side view, stationed off the intended central road route.
  R(c,'#363b34',x+2,y+32,74,5);
  R(c,'#6c533d',x+10,y+11,56,25);R(c,'#ab8659',x+10,y+12,56,17);
  for(let k=0;k<5;k++)R(c,k%2?'#896845':'#bd9a6b',x+13,y+16+k*3,51,2);
  R(c,'#674c35',x+14,y+4,17,11);R(c,'#9d7f59',x+16,y+6,13,5);
  R(c,'#6a5d45',x+35,y+3,20,12);R(c,'#bbb08d',x+37,y+4,16,6);
  if(condition==='repair'){
   R(c,'#c1a276',x+12,y+12,51,3);
   R(c,'#5f694b',x+33,y+2,3,26);
   R(c,'#c8b68e',x+29,y+7,12,3);
  }else if(condition==='return'){
   R(c,'#80745c',x+3,y+12,12,11);
   R(c,'#cdb78b',x+5,y+10,8,4);
  }else{
   // The visibly loose wooden brace is repaired or packed after the choice.
   R(c,'#4e4134',x+64,y+18,10,3);
   R(c,'#b5a075',x+66,y+13,3,8)
  }
  R(c,'#614936',x+8,y+10,4,23);R(c,'#614936',x+65,y+9,4,26);
  wheel(c,x+22,y+35);wheel(c,x+55,y+35);
 }
 function village(c,choices={}){
  // Sense of daily life; props at authored NPC landmarks, not imaginary loot.
  // Baker's stand: physically distinct from the mayor's house.
  const [bx,by]=at(7,5);
  R(c,'#544434',bx+1,by+21,62,8);R(c,'#b68b59',bx+2,by+15,60,8);
  for(let k=0;k<4;k++){let x=bx+8+k*13;R(c,'#ab8050',x,by+11,10,6);R(c,'#e3ba77',x+1,by+11,7,2)}
  R(c,'#ead5a4',bx+5,by+5,54,3);
  // Agricultural character of the village, crops rowed along the western field.
  for(let x=1;x<=3;x++)for(let y=8;y<=11;y++){
   const px=x*32+8,py=y*32+10;
   R(c,'#5b6547',px+1,py+12,17,4);
   for(let k=0;k<3;k++){
    R(c,'#355f3f',px+2+k*6,py+2,2,11);
    R(c,'#79935e',px+k*6,py+4,5,4)
   }
  }
  // Shared life around the well: buckets, filled water trough; no overlay on exit.
  const [wx,wy]=at(12,9);
  R(c,'#544632',wx+24,wy+26,13,4);
  R(c,'#9b7c53',wx+25,wy+16,11,12);
  R(c,'#658386',wx+27,wy+18,7,2);
  // Child's scattered play props outside the orphanage frontage.
  const [ox,oy]=at(18,6);
  R(c,'#a77b4a',ox+21,oy+24,7,6);
  R(c,'#dbbf85',ox+23,oy+25,3,2);
  R(c,'#806c8a',ox+9,oy+26,5,5);
  R(c,'#d3c09b',ox+10,oy+27,3,2);
  // Ren's actual practice interaction lives on (21,6). Its one-time player
  // choice stays visible in the normal game renderer and in a reloaded save.
  // No new remote art asset or floating quest decoration is needed.
  const [dx,dy]=at(21,6),practice=choices['early.renPractice'];
  R(c,'#4d4939',dx+3,dy+27,26,3);
  R(c,'#8a7655',dx+6,dy+25,22,2);
  if(practice==='strike'){
   // Knocked-down dummy: a physical memory of Triton's opening attack.
   R(c,'#795636',dx+4,dy+22,23,5);
   R(c,'#bf9562',dx+6,dy+22,18,2);
   R(c,'#574e3e',dx+9,dy+17,5,5);
   R(c,'#b09b77',dx+5,dy+14,14,3);
   R(c,'#9b7860',dx+17,dy+20,7,2);
  }else{
   R(c,'#634a33',dx+13,dy+7,5,21);
   R(c,'#ad8757',dx+13,dy+8,2,18);
   R(c,'#88704b',dx+8,dy+10,16,4);
   R(c,'#d0b48a',dx+10,dy+3,11,9);
   R(c,'#8e795c',dx+11,dy+4,9,2);
   R(c,'#5a4b3a',dx+12,dy+7,2,2);
   R(c,'#5a4b3a',dx+18,dy+7,2,2);
   if(practice==='guard'){
    // A lifted wooden shield: unlike the knocked dummy, it stays upright.
    R(c,'#3c594f',dx+4,dy+12,11,12);
    R(c,'#8cae96',dx+5,dy+13,9,8);
    R(c,'#d8bb7f',dx+9,dy+14,2,8);
    R(c,'#655442',dx+5,dy+23,9,2);
   }else{
    // A clean straw target tells the player there is something to try.
    R(c,'#c7ae80',dx+17,dy+15,7,8);
    R(c,'#84694f',dx+19,dy+17,3,4);
   }
  }
  // Village notice board is at the square rather than a floating HUD label.
  // No new solid board on a walkable square; the village door signs suffice.
  // Small footprints into lived-in door thresholds.
  for(const [x,y] of [[5,11],[18,11],[18,4],[4,4]]){
   R(c,'#988c70',x*32+7,y*32+26,9,2);
   R(c,'#b9ad8c',x*32+17,y*32+22,6,2)
  }
 }
 function road(c,choices={}){
  // Wheel ruts, erosion and roadside drainage give a true used-trade-route read.
  for(const [x,y] of [[11,13],[11,11],[11,9],[10,8],[11,6],[12,4],[12,3]]){
   const [px,py]=at(x,y);
   for(const dx of [7,22]){
    R(c,'#776c55',px+dx,py+5,2,19);
    R(c,'#aa9673',px+dx+1,py+8,1,9);
   }
   R(c,'#c4b28c',px+12,py+23,8,1)
  }
  c.save();c.translate(5*32+4,7*32+3);c.scale(.72,.72);cart(c,0,0,choices['early.merchantCart']);c.restore();
  // Lumber and tied parcels near the road's original merchant position.
  const [x,y]=at(8,8);
  R(c,'#584d3b',x+17,y+18,12,9);
  R(c,'#a48b64',x+19,y+16,9,10);
  R(c,'#c7aa78',x+21,y+17,4,2);
  // Weathered direction marker with no false clickable entrance.
  // The existing roadSign interactive object is the actual signpost.
  // Sparse, recognizable milestones: extra detail concentrated at bends.
  for(const [tx,ty] of [[5,11],[18,8],[19,2]]){
   const [px,py]=at(tx,ty);
   R(c,'#4d584a',px+6,py+23,20,6);
   R(c,'#818577',px+11,py+12,11,15);
   R(c,'#b5ad90',px+13,py+12,7,3);
   R(c,'#6c735f',px+11,py+21,11,2)
  }
 }
 function capital(c){
  // City shows prosperity and scarcity in neighboring, distinctly designed areas.
  // Market booth cloth, fruit baskets, rope, and packaging all on existing stalls.
  for(const [tx,ty,cloth] of [[3,7,'#a76655'],[5,9,'#aa8d58'],[7,7,'#628792']]){
   const [x,y]=at(tx,ty);
   R(c,'#4a4136',x+1,y+10,30,17);
   R(c,cloth,x+1,y+3,30,9);
   for(let k=0;k<3;k++)R(c,k%2?'#e1cfac':'#c8b086',x+3+k*10,y+3,8,3);
   R(c,'#d2b58a',x+4,y+15,24,3);
   for(const ox of [7,14,21]){
    R(c,'#ad7749',x+ox,y+18,6,4);
    R(c,'#d9a875',x+ox+1,y+18,4,1)
   }
  }
  // Ration line: restrained chalk and worn queue marks, not invented residents.
  for(const [tx,ty] of [[15,9],[16,9],[17,9],[15,10],[16,10]]){
   const [x,y]=at(tx,ty);
   R(c,'#d1c5b3',x+6,y+25,18,2);
   R(c,'#827a71',x+8,y+28,14,1);
  }
  basket(c,17*32+5,8*32+9,'empty');
  // Palatial side of the square retains rich stone inlays.
  for(const [tx,ty] of [[9,4],[12,4],[15,4]]){
   const [x,y]=at(tx,ty);
   R(c,'#cfc7b8',x+9,y+25,15,2);
   R(c,'#e4d7bb',x+11,y+24,11,1)
  }
  // Municipal announcement board ties into the existing propaganda object.
  // Use the existing victoryPoster object: no impassable-looking false board.
 }
 function ground(c,map,choices={}){if(!api.enabled)return false;
  if(map==='village')village(c,choices);
  else if(map==='road')road(c,choices);
  else if(map==='capital')capital(c);
  else return false;
  return true
 }
 function clothes(c,id,x,y){
  // Pixel costume accents atop the shared NPC body; distinct jobs at game scale.
  if(id==='baker'){
   R(c,'#d8cdb1',x+10,y+13,14,17);
   R(c,'#a38d6b',x+11,y+16,12,1);
   R(c,'#ece3cb',x+12,y+17,10,9);
   R(c,'#766b57',x+12,y+25,10,2);
  }else if(id==='farmer'){
   R(c,'#575d44',x+10,y+15,13,16);
   R(c,'#91936c',x+11,y+15,3,12);
   R(c,'#91936c',x+19,y+15,3,12);
   R(c,'#78634a',x+10,y-2,15,3);
   R(c,'#bca37a',x+6,y+1,22,3);
  }else if(id==='oldwoman'){
   R(c,'#857a72',x+7,y+9,20,8);
   R(c,'#c2b0a0',x+8,y+10,17,3);
   R(c,'#62595a',x+9,y+17,15,11);
  }else if(id==='merchant'){
   R(c,'#655c4a',x+9,y+10,17,5);
   R(c,'#a58c69',x+11,y+11,13,2);
   R(c,'#7e6d54',x+9,y+18,18,4);
   R(c,'#d1b78c',x+20,y+18,3,9);
  }else if(id==='capitalVendor'){
   R(c,'#bfac91',x+11,y+16,14,13);
   R(c,'#8a6d53',x+12,y+19,12,3);
  }else if(id==='rationMother'){
   R(c,'#6e7369',x+8,y+11,19,9);
   R(c,'#a6a18e',x+9,y+12,17,2);
   R(c,'#70675e',x+11,y+17,15,12);
  }else if(id==='capitalFlowerGirl'){
   R(c,'#c4a58d',x+11,y+17,12,12);
   R(c,'#8f6a6e',x+13,y+20,8,2);
  }else if(id==='capitalRecruit'){
   R(c,'#737a7d',x+9,y+16,16,14);
   R(c,'#c6b593',x+10,y+17,14,2);
   R(c,'#545a60',x+9,y+25,16,3);
  }else if(id==='orphan'){
   R(c,'#bea08a',x+12,y+17,11,11);
   R(c,'#947e72',x+14,y+18,7,2)
  }
 }
 // Only named, already-placed people have role-specific props.
 // Tool placement deliberately does not block the NPC's face or outline.
 const living=new Set(['baker','farmer','oldwoman','orphan','merchant','capitalVendor','rationMother','capitalFlowerGirl','capitalRecruit']);
 // Small task-specific movement: two deliberate arm poses per 8-11 second
 // cycle, never in-place marching. The same phase drives the dedicated NPC
 // sheet AND the held work prop so tray/tool pixels do not drift apart.
 function phasePeriod(id){
  if(id==='farmer'||id==='fieldWorker')return 11000;
  if(id==='baker'||id==='merchant')return 8000;
  if(id==='ren'||id==='capitalFlowerGirl')return 7800;
  if(id==='oldwoman'||id==='mayor'||id==='granz')return 12500;
  return 9500
 }
 function workPhase(id,now){
  if(!(now>0))return 0;
  if(typeof matchMedia==='function'&&matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches)return 0;
  const period=phasePeriod(id);
  const offset=(String(id).length*127)%1900;
  const t=(now+offset)%period;
  return t>=2200&&t<2700?1:t>=2700&&t<3200?3:0
 }
 // Idle scenery redraws only when an *observable hand pose* can change.
 // Otherwise the original 200ms timer constantly repaints the full world,
 // including while all workers spend ~90% of the cycle standing still.
 function nextWorkFrameDelay(map,playerX,playerY,npcs,now=Date.now()){
  if(!shouldBreathe(map,playerX,playerY,npcs))return Infinity;
  let earliest=Infinity;
  for(const n of npcs){
   if(!animatedWorkers.has(n.id)||Math.abs(n.x-playerX)+Math.abs(n.y-playerY)>5)continue;
   const period=phasePeriod(n.id);
   const offset=(String(n.id).length*127)%1900;
   const t=(now+offset)%period;
   const wait=t<2200?2200-t:t<2700?2700-t:t<3200?3200-t:period+2200-t;
   earliest=Math.min(earliest,wait);
  }
  return Number.isFinite(earliest)?Math.max(80,Math.ceil(earliest)):Infinity
 }
 function villager(c,map,n,now=0){
  if(!api.enabled||!living.has(n.id)||!maps.has(map))return false;
  const x=n.x*32,y=n.y*32;
  // New native gesture sheet already has the prop, arm and face painted into
  // each pose. The historical rectangular overlay obscured their artwork.
  if(typeof OpeningPixelAssets!=='undefined'&&
     OpeningPixelAssets.featuredNames?.includes(n.id)&&
     OpeningPixelAssets.featuredStatus?.().ready)return true;
  const beat=workPhase(n.id,now)===1?1:0;
  // The dedicated NPC atlas already includes distinct garments.
  // Only the old fallback renderer needs the historic costume overlay.
  if(typeof OpeningPixelAssets==='undefined'||!OpeningPixelAssets.designs[n.id])clothes(c,n.id,x,y);
  if(n.id==='baker'){
   // Tray of loaves makes the baker legible even without opening dialogue.
   R(c,'#725238',x+18,y+16-beat,19,5);
   for(let i=0;i<3;i++){R(c,'#d29b61',x+20+i*5,y+12-beat,5,5);R(c,'#e6c08b',x+21+i*5,y+13-beat,3,1)}
  }else if(n.id==='farmer'){
   R(c,'#725539',x+4,y-12+beat,3,30);
   R(c,'#b9ab88',x-1,y-16+beat,14,6);
   R(c,'#4b563d',x+3,y+15,5,4)
  }else if(n.id==='oldwoman'){
   R(c,'#5b4935',x+26,y+10,3,27);
   R(c,'#b0946d',x+25,y+8,5,4)
  }else if(n.id==='orphan'){
   R(c,'#9a675d',x+21,y+15+beat,6,6);
   R(c,'#d8af8d',x+23,y+13+beat,3,3)
  }else if(n.id==='merchant'){
   // Non-looping ledger pose and a sack show merchant identity.
   R(c,'#7f6750',x+20,y+18,12,9);
   R(c,'#d9c5a1',x+20,y+9-beat,10,8);
   R(c,'#8c745d',x+22,y+12-beat,6,1)
  }else if(n.id==='capitalVendor'){
   basket(c,x+17,y+10);
  }else if(n.id==='rationMother'){
   basket(c,x+17,y+15,'empty');
   R(c,'#c1ac8b',x+19,y+14-beat,6,3)
  }else if(n.id==='capitalFlowerGirl'){
   R(c,'#ab7951',x+19,y+16,9,10);
   for(const dx of [20,25]){R(c,'#5c8252',x+dx+1,y+10-beat,2,8);R(c,'#a85e6c',x+dx-1,y+9-beat,5,4)}
  }else if(n.id==='capitalRecruit'){
   R(c,'#8b8272',x+23,y+12,3,17);
   R(c,'#c8c2af',x+21,y+10,7,3)
  }
  return true
 }
 // Only existing indoor workers get a restrained held-item gesture, so
 // the planned idle-frame update has a physical object to animate.
 function workplace(c,map,n,now=0){
  const eligible=(
   map==='mayorhouse'&&n.id==='clerk'||
   map==='capitalarmory'&&['capitalSmith','armoryApprentice'].includes(n.id)||
   map==='capitalinn'&&n.id==='capitalInnHost'
  );
  if(!eligible)return false;
  const frame=workPhase(n.id,now),lift=frame===1?-1:frame===3?1:0;
  const x=n.x*32,y=n.y*32;
  if(n.id==='clerk'){
   // Ledger rests near the clerk's writing hand, not over the face.
   R(c,'#79664e',x+23,y+19+lift,9,6);
   R(c,'#d6c5a2',x+24,y+18+lift,7,5);
   R(c,'#77675a',x+26,y+20+lift,4,1);
  }else if(n.id==='capitalSmith'){
   // The weight stays low: never strike empty air above the NPC.
   R(c,'#6e5545',x+26,y+17+lift,3,10);
   R(c,'#a6aaac',x+23,y+15+lift,9,4);
  }else if(n.id==='armoryApprentice'){
   R(c,'#b8a889',x+24,y+20+lift,7,4);
   R(c,'#817c72',x+25,y+21+lift,5,1);
  }else if(n.id==='capitalInnHost'){
   // A room key/guest receipt, not a random rhythmic hand wave.
   R(c,'#d0b992',x+25,y+19+lift,6,6);
   R(c,'#77624d',x+27,y+21+lift,3,1);
  }
  return true
 }
 // The brook watcher surveys the stream from a fixed position, not a walking
 // or hand-waving animation. Only the farm worker uses sparse working poses.
 // Indoor workshops also have genuinely working NPCs. Ordinary stationary
 // civilians must not trigger wasteful, in-place walking cycles.
 const ambientWorkplaces=new Set(['village','ryunefields','ryunebrook','road','capital','capitalarmory','capitalinn','mayorhouse']);
 const animatedWorkers=new Set(['baker','farmer','merchant','capitalVendor','capitalFlowerGirl',
  'capitalSmith','armoryApprentice','clerk','capitalInnHost','fieldWorker',
  'oldwoman','mayor','messenger','ren','capitalRecruit','granz']);
 function shouldBreathe(map,playerX,playerY,npcs){
  if(!api.enabled||!ambientWorkplaces.has(map))return false;
  if(typeof matchMedia==='function'&&matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches)return false;
  return Array.isArray(npcs)&&npcs.some(n=>animatedWorkers.has(n.id)&&Math.abs(n.x-playerX)+Math.abs(n.y-playerY)<=5)
 }
 // These stalls were already represented as solid-looking art in the old capital.
 // Preserve map symbols but align physical movement with that presentation.
 function blocks(map,x,y){
  return map==='capital'&&((x===3&&y===7)||(x===7&&y===7)||(x===17&&y===8))
 }
 const api={enabled:true,maps,ground,villager,living,workplace,shouldBreathe,blocks,workPhase,nextWorkFrameDelay};
 return api
})();

</script>
<script data-origin="js/render/ryune_outskirts.js">
'use strict';
// Small authored pixel environments for two OPTIONAL early village excursions.
// Terrain and collisions are owned exclusively by js/data/maps.js.
const RyuneOutskirts=(()=>{
 const maps=new Set(['ryunefields','ryunebrook']);
 const viewer={x:-99,y:-99};
 function waterMotion(map,x,y){
  if(map!=='ryunebrook')return false;
  if(typeof matchMedia==='function'&&matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches)return false;
  return Number.isFinite(x)&&Number.isFinite(y)&&
   Math.min(Math.abs(x-12),Math.abs(x-13))+Math.abs(y-7)<=5
 }
 function setViewer(x,y){viewer.x=x;viewer.y=y}
 function nextWaterFrameDelay(map,x,y,now=Date.now()){
  return waterMotion(map,x,y)?Math.max(80,700-(now%700)):Infinity
 }

 const W=32;
 const pixel=(c,col,x,y,w,h)=>{c.fillStyle=col;c.fillRect(x|0,y|0,w|0,h|0)};
 const hash=(x,y)=>((Math.imul(x+17,73856093)^Math.imul(y+23,19349663))>>>0);
 function drawPath(c,x,y){
  pixel(c,'#a99573',x,y,W,W);
  pixel(c,'#bbaa86',x+2,y+2,28,2);
  pixel(c,'#857859',x+7,y+19,11,2);
  pixel(c,'#d0bc8e',x+21,y+12,5,1);
 }
 function drawGrass(c,x,y,h){
  pixel(c,'#637b59',x,y,W,W);
  pixel(c,'#74865a',x+(h%17),y+7,7,3);
  pixel(c,'#45674b',x+6,y+21,3,4);
  pixel(c,'#91a16e',x+24,y+9,3,2);
 }
 function paintTile(c,map,ch,tx,ty){
  // The two village hedgerow gaps are visual-only; movement owns the exits.
  if(map==='village'&&ty===8&&(tx===0||tx===23)){
   drawPath(c,tx*W,ty*W);return true
  }
  if(!maps.has(map))return false;
  const x=tx*W,y=ty*W,h=hash(tx,ty);
  if(ch==='P'){
   drawPath(c,x,y);
   if(map==='ryunebrook'&&(tx===12||tx===13)){
    pixel(c,'#4a6771',x,y,32,32);
    for(let k=0;k<4;k++){
     pixel(c,'#624c35',x,y+k*8,32,6);
     pixel(c,'#b09469',x+2,y+k*8,27,3);
     pixel(c,'#3d3b31',x+7+(k%2)*12,y+k*8+4,2,2);
    }
   }
   return true;
  }
  if(ch==='Z'){
   // A narrow river highlight shifts by a few *whole pixels* only when nearby.
   // Never move a collision boundary or overlay the existing wooden bridge.
   const flow=waterMotion&&waterMotion(map,viewer.x,viewer.y)?
    Math.floor(Date.now()/700)%4:0;
   pixel(c,'#3d6b77',x,y,32,32);
   pixel(c,'#568e98',x+2,y+4,22,2);
   pixel(c,'#7aa8a9',x+10+flow*2,y+14,12,2);
   pixel(c,'#2e5265',x+4,y+25,22,3);
   return true;
  }
  if(ch==='D'){
   pixel(c,'#806947',x,y,32,32);
   for(let k=0;k<3;k++){
    pixel(c,'#594c38',x+3,y+4+k*10,27,3);
    pixel(c,'#aa855b',x+3,y+7+k*10,27,2);
    if((h+k)%3!==0){
     pixel(c,'#3a704c',x+9+((h>>k)%6),y+1+k*10,3,9);
     pixel(c,'#8aa467',x+6+((h>>k)%6),y+3+k*10,8,3);
    }
   }
   return true;
  }
  if(ch==='T'||ch==='H'){
   drawGrass(c,x,y,h);
   pixel(c,'#3f5543',x+5,y+14,22,17);
   pixel(c,'#4f6847',x+3,y+6,27,15);
   pixel(c,'#76905b',x+6,y+5,18,5);
   pixel(c,'#a7ad75',x+13,y+4,6,3);
   return true;
  }
  drawGrass(c,x,y,h);
  return true;
 }
 function drawAccents(c,map){
  if(map==='village'){
   // Clear passable corridors without drawing obstacles over the actual path.
   for(const [x,side] of [[0,'west'],[23,'east']]){
    const px=x*W,py=7*W;
    pixel(c,'#4d4939',px+8,py+8,3,24);
    pixel(c,side==='west'?'#b99c69':'#95adb2',px+3,py+4,25,6);
    pixel(c,'#e0c69a',px+5,py+5,15,2);
   }
   return
  }
  if(map==='ryunefields'){
   // Hay and irrigation staves stay on nonessential cells; no fake blockers.
   for(const [x,y] of [[3,11],[17,3],[6,5]]){
    const px=x*W,py=y*W;
    pixel(c,'#d3b071',px+8,py+17,20,8);
    pixel(c,'#876c48',px+7,py+22,22,3);
    pixel(c,'#e4c78a',px+12,py+15,10,2);
   }
   pixel(c,'#786746',11*W+13,3*W+9,5,35);
  }else if(map==='ryunebrook'){
   for(const y of [2,4,10,12]){
    pixel(c,'#a6a284',11*W+22,y*W+18,7,4);
    pixel(c,'#4a7b6d',14*W+2,y*W+21,12,4);
   }
   // A shallow, unblocked shoreline. Water itself remains collision-coded Z.
   pixel(c,'#ae9c78',10*W+26,5*W+20,7,8);
   pixel(c,'#cbba8e',10*W+27,5*W+18,5,3);
  }
 }
 function drawObject(c,map,o,alreadyTaken=false){
  if(map==='village'&&(o.id==='westFieldPath'||o.id==='eastBrookPath')){
   const x=o.x*W,y=o.y*W;
   pixel(c,'#574536',x+14,y+6,4,26);
   pixel(c,o.id==='westFieldPath'?'#c1a26f':'#89acb6',x+4,y+5,25,8);
   pixel(c,'#e2d2a3',x+7,y+7,18,2);
   pixel(c,'#483d35',x+15,y+22,7,3);
   return true
  }
  if(!maps.has(map))return false;
  // Once collected, the supply spot is walkable again: do not leave a solid-looking crate.
  if(alreadyTaken&&(o.id==='fieldCache'||o.id==='brookCache'))return true;
  const x=o.x*W,y=o.y*W;
  if(o.id==='fieldFurrows'){
   pixel(c,'#423e30',x+5,y+20,23,4);
   pixel(c,'#c2a576',x+7,y+18,19,2);
   for(let k=0;k<3;k++){pixel(c,'#48734d',x+8+k*7,y+12,3,8);pixel(c,'#a4b879',x+7+k*7,y+12,6,3)}
  }else if(o.id==='fieldCart'){
   pixel(c,'#594b3a',x+2,y+13,28,10);
   pixel(c,'#c0a06d',x+5,y+8,22,11);
   for(const px of [7,23]){pixel(c,'#393b32',x+px-3,y+23,8,7);pixel(c,'#978b68',x+px-1,y+25,4,3)}
  }else if(o.id==='fieldCache'||o.id==='brookCache'){
   pixel(c,'#6a5340',x+4,y+18,24,12);
   pixel(c,alreadyTaken?'#4b4e47':'#c9a879',x+6,y+14,20,6);
   pixel(c,'#443b2e',x+13,y+21,6,2);
  }else if(o.id==='brookWater'){
   pixel(c,'#c0ae86',x+3,y+20,23,5);
   pixel(c,'#d9c69b',x+10,y+15,10,4);
   pixel(c,'#6b9b9a',x+23,y+26,6,2);
  }else if(o.id==='brookStones'){
   for(const [xx,yy] of [[3,15],[11,10],[20,17]]){
    pixel(c,'#646e67',x+xx,y+yy,9,9);
    pixel(c,'#b5afa0',x+xx+2,y+yy+1,5,2);
   }
  }else return false;
  return true
 }
 // The village remembers voluntary choices WITHOUT magically repairing the
 // stream or requiring a side quest. All accents remain on existing props.
 function drawProgress(c,map,choices={},completed={}){
  if(map==='village'){
   if(choices['early.orphanMedicine']==='donate'){
    // A quiet wrapped medicine packet near the established orphanage doorstep.
    const x=19*W+22,y=5*W+23;
    pixel(c,'#65523b',x-1,y-1,9,7);
    pixel(c,'#e2d5b5',x,y,7,5);
    pixel(c,'#819376',x+3,y,1,5);
   }
   if(completed['ryune.outskirts.reward']){
    // Brought-back notes stay with Boru; no invented construction complete.
    const x=7*W+3,y=12*W+22;
    pixel(c,'#645342',x,y,10,6);
    pixel(c,'#d6c39b',x+2,y-2,7,5);
    pixel(c,'#88795f',x+3,y,4,1);
   }
  }else if(map==='ryunefields'&&completed['ryune.outskirts.reported.fields']){
   // Two slim measuring pegs placed beside, not across, the dry furrow.
   for(const x of [7*W+26,8*W+3]){
    const y=4*W+11;
    pixel(c,'#625037',x,y,2,17);
    pixel(c,'#c5b089',x-2,y+7,7,2);
   }
  }else if(map==='ryunebrook'&&completed['ryune.outskirts.reported.brook']){
   // Only a small water-level marker; the blocked water is still blocked.
   const x=11*W+24,y=5*W+8;
   pixel(c,'#665541',x,y,2,23);
   pixel(c,'#cab390',x-3,y+12,8,2);
   pixel(c,'#cab390',x-3,y+17,6,1);
  }
 }
 return {maps,paintTile,drawAccents,drawObject,drawProgress,setViewer,waterMotion,nextWaterFrameDelay};
})();

</script>

function drawTerrainBlend(m){if(RyuneOutskirts.maps.has(state.map))return;if(AshFrontierEnvironment.enabled&&AshFrontierEnvironment.targets.has(state.map))return;if(CapitalEnvironment.enabled&&CapitalEnvironment.mapsSupported.has(state.map))return;if(RoadCaveQuality.enabled&&RoadCaveQuality.active.has(state.map))return;if(RyuneEnvironment.enabled&&RyuneEnvironment.targets.has(state.map))return;
 const walk=new Set(['G','Q','P','D','A','E','B','M','F']);
 for(let y=0;y<ROWS;y++)for(let x=0;x<COLS;x++){
  const ch=m.tiles[y][x],px=x*TILE,py=y*TILE;if(!walk.has(ch))continue;
  const right=x+1<COLS?m.tiles[y][x+1]:null,down=y+1<ROWS?m.tiles[y+1][x]:null;
  if(right===ch){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.012)';ctx.fillRect(px+TILE-2,py,4,TILE)}
  if(down===ch){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.012)';ctx.fillRect(px,py+TILE-2,TILE,4)}
 }
 // Commercial pass: no giant translucent ovals. Use restrained micro-texture
 // so the ground supports the characters instead of looking procedurally stained.
 const seed=state.map.length*31;
 for(let i=0;i<54;i++){
  const sx=(i*137+seed*17)%(COLS*TILE),sy=(i*83+seed*29)%(ROWS*TILE),w=2+(i%4),h=1+(i%2);
  ctx.fillStyle=i%3===0?'rgba(232,218,172,.045)':'rgba(35,48,35,.05)';
  ctx.fillRect(Math.round(sx),Math.round(sy),w,h)
 }
}

function drawVerticalSliceGround(m){if(RyuneOutskirts.maps.has(state.map))return;if(AshFrontierEnvironment.enabled&&AshFrontierEnvironment.targets.has(state.map))return;if(CapitalEnvironment.enabled&&CapitalEnvironment.mapsSupported.has(state.map))return;if(RoadCaveQuality.enabled&&RoadCaveQuality.active.has(state.map))return;if(RyuneEnvironment.enabled&&RyuneEnvironment.targets.has(state.map))return;
 const map=state.map;
 if(map==='village'){
  // broad, irregular footpath shoulders hide the square tile seam
  ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=.24;ctx.fillStyle='#b59a6a';for(let y=1;y<14;y++){const wob=(y%4-1.5)*3;ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(12*TILE+wob, y*TILE+16,37+(y%3)*4,22,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill()}ctx.restore();
  // small patches and flower clusters crossing tile borders
  for(let i=0;i<18;i++){const x=(i*41+57)%720+24,y=(i*73+91)%390+35;ctx.fillStyle=i%3?'rgba(55,84,48,.26)':'rgba(198,171,89,.28)';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y,7+(i%4)*3,3+(i%3)*2,(i%5)*.25,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill()}
 }
 if(map==='road'){
  // Continuous travelled-road surface. Collision still follows the tile map,
  // but presentation no longer exposes square 32px path stamps.
  const centers=[12,12,11,11,10,10,10,11,12,12,11,11,12,12,12];
  const path=(width,stroke)=>{ctx.strokeStyle=stroke;ctx.lineWidth=width;ctx.lineCap='round';ctx.lineJoin='round';ctx.beginPath();for(let y=0;y<centers.length;y++){const x=centers[y]*TILE+16,yy=y*TILE+16;if(!y)ctx.moveTo(x,yy);else ctx.lineTo(x,yy)}ctx.stroke()};
  path(92,'rgba(74,72,48,.34)');path(82,'#ad9569');path(72,'#b9a174');
  // Irregular shoulder pixels and compacted center patches.
  for(let i=0;i<42;i++){const y=(i*37)%450+8,ri=Math.max(0,Math.min(14,Math.floor(y/TILE))),cx=centers[ri]*TILE+16,side=i%2?1:-1;ctx.fillStyle=i%3?'rgba(64,88,52,.31)':'rgba(95,72,43,.19)';ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx+side*(41+(i%5)*3)),Math.round(y),2+(i%3),3+(i%4))}
  // Wheel ruts follow the same actual route.
  for(const off of [-10,10]){ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(91,68,43,.30)';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.beginPath();for(let y=0;y<centers.length;y++){const x=centers[y]*TILE+16+off,yy=y*TILE+16;if(!y)ctx.moveTo(x,yy);else ctx.lineTo(x,yy)}ctx.stroke()}
 } if(map==='capital'){
  // large paving bands and gutters ignore tile boundaries and make the plaza one continuous material
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(242,229,196,.055)';ctx.fillRect(9*TILE,4*TILE,6*TILE,9*TILE);ctx.fillStyle='rgba(54,58,61,.17)';ctx.fillRect(11*TILE-4,4*TILE,3,10*TILE);ctx.fillRect(13*TILE+1,4*TILE,3,10*TILE);
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(211,190,145,.13)';ctx.lineWidth=2;for(let y=5;y<13;y+=2){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(8*TILE,y*TILE+10);ctx.lineTo(16*TILE,y*TILE+10);ctx.stroke()}
 }
 if(INTERIOR_MAPS.includes(map)){
  // long planks run across multiple logical cells, removing the checkerboard feeling indoors
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(64,42,27,.18)';ctx.lineWidth=1;for(let y=3;y<=12;y++){const yy=y*TILE+((y%2)*7);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(4*TILE+5,yy);ctx.lineTo(20*TILE-5,yy);ctx.stroke();for(let x=5+(y%3);x<20;x+=4){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x*TILE+7,yy-15);ctx.lineTo(x*TILE+7,yy);ctx.stroke()}}
 }
}
function drawHouse(h){const px=h.x*TILE,py=h.y*TILE,w=TILE*3;
 // deep shadow and stone foundation
 ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.28)';ctx.fillRect(px+10,py+38,w-2,58);ctx.fillStyle='#6b6257';ctx.fillRect(px+8,py+78,w-16,14);
 // wall with timber frame
 ctx.fillStyle=h.wall;ctx.fillRect(px+7,py+31,w-14,58);ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,247,220,.09)';ctx.fillRect(px+10,py+34,w-20,5);
 ctx.fillStyle='#584234';ctx.fillRect(px+9,py+39,w-18,4);ctx.fillRect(px+39,py+33,4,56);ctx.fillRect(px+70,py+33,4,56);
 // layered roof and shingles
 ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.25)';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(px-5,py+39);ctx.lineTo(px+w/2,py+3);ctx.lineTo(px+w+6,py+39);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
 ctx.fillStyle=h.roof;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(px-3,py+34);ctx.lineTo(px+w/2,py+1);ctx.lineTo(px+w+3,py+34);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();
 ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(45,29,24,.28)';ctx.lineWidth=1;for(let yy=13;yy<34;yy+=7){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(px+15-(yy-13)*.5,py+yy);ctx.lineTo(px+w-15+(yy-13)*.5,py+yy);ctx.stroke()}
 for(let xx=17;xx<w-10;xx+=16){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(px+xx,py+18);ctx.lineTo(px+xx+7,py+28);ctx.stroke()}
 // chimney
 ctx.fillStyle='#65534a';ctx.fillRect(px+w-27,py+7,13,25);ctx.fillStyle='#837166';ctx.fillRect(px+w-29,py+5,17,5);
 // door and windows
 ctx.fillStyle='#6d523a';ctx.fillRect(px+40,py+57,20,32);ctx.fillStyle='#31251d';ctx.fillRect(px+55,py+73,3,3);
 for(const wx of [16,66]){ctx.fillStyle='#b8d8df';ctx.fillRect(px+wx,py+50,20,16);ctx.fillStyle='rgba(246,213,128,.2)';ctx.fillRect(px+wx+3,py+53,14,10);ctx.strokeStyle='#5d5042';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.strokeRect(px+wx,py+50,20,16);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(px+wx+10,py+50);ctx.lineTo(px+wx+10,py+66);ctx.moveTo(px+wx,py+58);ctx.lineTo(px+wx+20,py+58);ctx.stroke()}
 // crates, flower box, sign
 ctx.fillStyle='#775538';ctx.fillRect(px+10,py+72,19,13);ctx.strokeStyle='#a77b4e';ctx.strokeRect(px+10,py+72,19,13);ctx.fillStyle='#72503a';ctx.fillRect(px+66,py+68,21,7);ctx.fillStyle='#d3a958';for(const dx of [70,77,84]){ctx.fillRect(px+dx,py+64,3,4)}
 // no floating building-name plate: doors and in-world signs carry navigation now
 ctx.fillStyle='#5a4430';ctx.fillRect(px+35,py+86,30,4);ctx.fillStyle='rgba(220,196,143,.18)';ctx.fillRect(px+38,py+86,24,1)}
function drawCharacterSprite(x,y,style={},leader=false,facing='down',motion=0){
 if(style.heroId&&drawHeroSpriteSheet(x,y,style.heroId,leader,facing,motion))return;
 const px=x*TILE,py=y*TILE,small=style.small?.84:1,walk=Math.sin(motion)*2.2,bob=Math.abs(Math.sin(motion))*1.1,side=facing==='left'||facing==='right',back=facing==='up',flip=facing==='left'?-1:1;
 const cx=px+16,baseY=py+1-bob,skin=COLORS.skin,body=style.body||'#776a5e',accent=style.accent||'#c2ad86',hair=style.hair||'#443b34';
 ctx.fillStyle='rgba(16,18,18,.34)';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(cx,py+29,side?9:10,4,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
 if(side){
  // legs read clearly as a side walk instead of a front-facing slide
  ctx.fillStyle='#37312d';ctx.fillRect(cx-5+walk*.35,baseY+23,4,7);ctx.fillRect(cx+2-walk*.35,baseY+23,4,7);
  ctx.fillStyle=body;ctx.fillRect(cx-6,baseY+13,12,12);ctx.fillStyle=accent;ctx.fillRect(cx-6,baseY+13,12,4);
  if(style.cape){ctx.fillStyle='#263f67';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(cx-flip*5,baseY+15);ctx.lineTo(cx-flip*9,baseY+27);ctx.lineTo(cx-flip*3,baseY+25);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill()}
  // arm swing and profile face
  ctx.fillStyle=skin;ctx.fillRect(cx+flip*4,baseY+17+walk*.25,4,8);ctx.fillRect(cx-flip*7,baseY+17-walk*.25,4,7);
  ctx.fillStyle=skin;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx+flip*2,baseY+9,7*small,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle=hair;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(cx+flip*1,baseY+7,7*small,Math.PI,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.fillRect(cx-6,baseY+3,11,4);
  ctx.fillStyle='#4e3a33';ctx.fillRect(cx+flip*7-(flip<0?2:0),baseY+9,2,2);
  if(style.hat){ctx.fillStyle='#5a4632';ctx.fillRect(cx-9,baseY+3,18,3);ctx.fillRect(cx-5,baseY,11,5)}
  if(style.weapon==='sword'){ctx.strokeStyle='#d7dbe0';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(cx-flip*5,baseY+14);ctx.lineTo(cx-flip*10,baseY+27);ctx.stroke()}
  if(style.weapon==='staff'){ctx.strokeStyle='#6c5135';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(cx-flip*7,baseY+10);ctx.lineTo(cx-flip*7,baseY+29);ctx.stroke()}
 }else{
  const legA=walk*.5,legB=-walk*.5;
  ctx.fillStyle='#37312d';ctx.fillRect(px+10+legA,baseY+23,5,7);ctx.fillRect(px+18+legB,baseY+23,5,7);
  ctx.fillStyle=body;ctx.fillRect(px+9,baseY+13,14,12);ctx.fillStyle=accent;ctx.fillRect(px+9,baseY+13,14,4);
  // arms visibly alternate while moving
  ctx.fillStyle=skin;ctx.fillRect(px+6,baseY+16+walk*.28,4,8);ctx.fillRect(px+23,baseY+16-walk*.28,4,8);
  if(style.cape){ctx.fillStyle='#263f67';ctx.fillRect(px+7,baseY+15,3,12);ctx.fillRect(px+22,baseY+15,3,12)}
  ctx.fillStyle=skin;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(px+16,baseY+9,7*small,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.fillStyle=hair;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(px+16,baseY+7,7*small,Math.PI,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.fillRect(px+10,baseY+3,12,4);
  if(back){ctx.fillStyle=hair;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(px+16,baseY+10,6*small,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.fillStyle=body;ctx.fillRect(px+10,baseY+14,12,5)}
  else{ctx.fillStyle='#493b35';ctx.fillRect(px+12,baseY+9,2,2);ctx.fillRect(px+19,baseY+9,2,2)}
  if(style.hat){ctx.fillStyle='#5a4632';ctx.fillRect(px+7,baseY+3,18,3);ctx.fillRect(px+10,baseY,12,5)}
  if(style.weapon==='sword'){ctx.strokeStyle='#d7dbe0';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(px+24,baseY+13);ctx.lineTo(px+29,baseY+26);ctx.stroke()}
  if(style.weapon==='staff'){ctx.strokeStyle='#6c5135';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(px+6,baseY+10);ctx.lineTo(px+7,baseY+29);ctx.stroke();ctx.fillStyle=accent;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(px+6,baseY+8,3,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill()}
 }
 if(leader){ctx.fillStyle='#f0d178';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(cx,py-5);ctx.lineTo(cx+5,py-11);ctx.lineTo(cx,py-16);ctx.lineTo(cx-5,py-11);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(66,46,20,.8)';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.stroke()}
}
function facingBetween(a,b,fallback='down'){if(!a||!b)return fallback;const dx=b[0]-a[0],dy=b[1]-a[1];if(Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy))return dx<0?'left':'right';if(dy!==0)return dy<0?'up':'down';return fallback}
function drawLeaderWorldMarker(x,y){const px=Math.round(x*TILE),py=Math.round(y*TILE),footX=px+16,footY=py+30;ctx.save();ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(228,195,111,.74)';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(footX,footY-1,11,4,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,238,178,.28)';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(footX,footY-1,8,2.5,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();ctx.restore()}
function drawPartyRuntime(leaderMoving,phase){
 const actors=[],trailPoints=partyTrailPoints(),visibleParty=activeRouteParty();
 for(let i=Math.min(visibleParty.length-2,trailPoints.length-1);i>=0;i--){
 const p=trailPoints[i],vp=VISUAL.followers[i]||p,member=visibleParty[i+1],
  moving=Math.hypot(p[0]-vp[0],p[1]-vp[1])>.022;
 actors.push({x:vp[0],y:vp[1],style:PARTY_STYLE[member?.id]||PARTY_STYLE.triton,
  facing:VISUAL.followerFaces[i]||state.dir,motion:moving?VISUAL.followerPhases[i]:0,leader:false});
}
 actors.push({x:VISUAL.playerX,y:VISUAL.playerY,style:PARTY_STYLE.karen,facing:state.dir,motion:leaderMoving?VISUAL.travelPhase:0,leader:true});
 actors.sort((a,b)=>(a.y-b.y)||(a.x-b.x)||(a.leader?1:-1));
 GC.CommercialActing?.beginFrame?.(actors);
 for(const a of actors){
  const expressed=a.style?.heroId&&GC.CommercialActing?.draws?.(a.style.heroId,ctx,a.x,a.y,a.facing);
  if(!expressed)drawCharacterSprite(a.x,a.y,a.style,false,a.facing,a.motion);
 }
 drawLeaderWorldMarker(VISUAL.playerX,VISUAL.playerY)
}
function colorMix(hex,amount){
 const h=(hex||'#777777').replace('#','');if(h.length!==6)return hex||'#777777';
 const n=parseInt(h,16),r=n>>16,g=(n>>8)&255,b=n&255,t=amount<0?0:255,p=Math.abs(amount);
 const q=v=>Math.max(0,Math.min(255,Math.round(v+(t-v)*p)));
 return '#'+[q(r),q(g),q(b)].map(v=>v.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('')
}
function npcHash(id){let h=0;for(const ch of String(id||''))h=(h*31+ch.charCodeAt(0))>>>0;return h}
function drawNpcCommercial(n,facing='down'){
 // Render independent 4-direction, 4-pose pixel sprites where authored.
 // Do not paint the old generic body on top.
 if(typeof OpeningPixelAssets!=='undefined'&&OpeningPixelAssets.drawNpc(ctx,n,facing,
  Math.abs(state.x-n.x)+Math.abs(state.y-n.y)<=5?Date.now():0))return true;
 const s=NPC_STYLE[n.id]||{body:'#756b5f',accent:'#a58d6d',hair:'#4b4037'},h=npcHash(n.id),scale=s.small?.86:1;
 const px=n.x*TILE,py=n.y*TILE,cx=px+16,footY=py+30,body=s.body||'#756b5f',accent=s.accent||'#a58d6d',hair=s.hair||'#4b4037';
 const dark=colorMix(body,-.48),shade=colorMix(body,-.22),light=colorMix(body,.16),hairDark=colorMix(hair,-.34),skin='#d9b294',skinShade='#b9826f';
 ctx.save();ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
 ctx.fillStyle='rgba(9,12,14,.26)';ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(cx,footY,9*scale,3.2*scale,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
 const ox=Math.round(cx-14*scale),top=Math.round(footY-35*scale);
 // cloak / rear silhouette
 if(s.cape){ctx.fillStyle=colorMix(body,-.34);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(cx-10*scale,top+17*scale);ctx.lineTo(cx+10*scale,top+17*scale);ctx.lineTo(cx+13*scale,footY-5);ctx.lineTo(cx-13*scale,footY-5);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill()}
 // legs and boots
 ctx.fillStyle='#2d2a29';ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx-7*scale),Math.round(footY-9*scale),5*scale,9*scale);ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx+2*scale),Math.round(footY-9*scale),5*scale,9*scale);
 ctx.fillStyle='#493a31';ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx-8*scale),Math.round(footY-3*scale),6*scale,3*scale);ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx+2*scale),Math.round(footY-3*scale),6*scale,3*scale);
 // torso with readable outline + accent band
 ctx.fillStyle=dark;ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx-10*scale),Math.round(top+16*scale),20*scale,18*scale);
 ctx.fillStyle=body;ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx-8*scale),Math.round(top+17*scale),16*scale,16*scale);
 ctx.fillStyle=light;ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx-7*scale),Math.round(top+18*scale),14*scale,3*scale);
 ctx.fillStyle=accent;ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx-8*scale),Math.round(top+23*scale),16*scale,3*scale);
 // arms / hands
 ctx.fillStyle=shade;ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx-12*scale),Math.round(top+19*scale),5*scale,12*scale);ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx+7*scale),Math.round(top+19*scale),5*scale,12*scale);
 ctx.fillStyle=skin;ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx-12*scale),Math.round(top+29*scale),4*scale,4*scale);ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx+8*scale),Math.round(top+29*scale),4*scale,4*scale);
 // head + ears
 ctx.fillStyle=hairDark;ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx-9*scale),Math.round(top+2*scale),18*scale,14*scale);
 ctx.fillStyle=skinShade;ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx-8*scale),Math.round(top+6*scale),16*scale,12*scale);
 ctx.fillStyle=skin;ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx-7*scale),Math.round(top+6*scale),14*scale,10*scale);
 // hair cap / side locks vary by NPC id
 ctx.fillStyle=hair;ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx-8*scale),Math.round(top+2*scale),16*scale,6*scale);
 if(h%3===0){ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx-9*scale),Math.round(top+5*scale),4*scale,10*scale);ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx+5*scale),Math.round(top+5*scale),4*scale,10*scale)}
 else if(h%3===1){ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx-8*scale),Math.round(top+5*scale),5*scale,7*scale);ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx+4*scale),Math.round(top+5*scale),4*scale,5*scale)}
 else{ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx-9*scale),Math.round(top+5*scale),3*scale,8*scale);ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx+6*scale),Math.round(top+5*scale),3*scale,8*scale)}
 // face at gameplay scale. Nearby NPCs turn toward the player instead of
 // remaining permanently front-facing.
 if(facing==='up'){
  ctx.fillStyle=hair;ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx-7*scale),Math.round(top+7*scale),14*scale,9*scale);
  ctx.fillStyle=hairDark;ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx-5*scale),Math.round(top+14*scale),10*scale,3*scale)
 }else if(facing==='left'||facing==='right'){
  const dir=facing==='left'?-1:1;
  ctx.fillStyle='#473a34';ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx+dir*2*scale),Math.round(top+11*scale),2*scale,2*scale);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.62)';ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx+dir*2*scale),Math.round(top+10*scale),1*scale,1*scale);
  ctx.fillStyle=hair;ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx-dir*8*scale),Math.round(top+6*scale),5*scale,9*scale);
  if(h%4!==0){ctx.fillStyle='#9c645d';ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx+dir*3*scale),Math.round(top+15*scale),2*scale,1*scale)}
 }else{
  ctx.fillStyle='#473a34';ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx-4*scale),Math.round(top+11*scale),2*scale,2*scale);ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx+3*scale),Math.round(top+11*scale),2*scale,2*scale);
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(255,255,255,.62)';ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx-4*scale),Math.round(top+10*scale),1*scale,1*scale);
  if(h%4!==0){ctx.fillStyle='#9c645d';ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx-1*scale),Math.round(top+15*scale),3*scale,1*scale)}
 }
 // role accessories
 if(s.hat){ctx.fillStyle=colorMix(hair,-.15);ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx-11*scale),Math.round(top+1*scale),22*scale,3*scale);ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx-7*scale),Math.round(top-2*scale),14*scale,5*scale)}
 if(s.weapon==='sword'){ctx.strokeStyle='#aeb8bf';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(cx+10*scale,top+20*scale);ctx.lineTo(cx+14*scale,footY-2);ctx.stroke()}
 if(s.weapon==='staff'){ctx.strokeStyle='#765438';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(cx-11*scale,top+12*scale);ctx.lineTo(cx-12*scale,footY);ctx.stroke();ctx.fillStyle=accent;ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx-14*scale),Math.round(top+9*scale),5*scale,5*scale)}
 // Selected high-contact villagers gain distinct posture/work silhouettes.
  // These are presentation accents, not new costume/canon claims.
  if(n.id==='messenger'){
   ctx.fillStyle=accent;ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx-12*scale),Math.round(top+17*scale),5*scale,3*scale);
   ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx+7*scale),Math.round(top+17*scale),5*scale,3*scale);
  }else if(n.id==='mayor'){
   ctx.fillStyle=accent;ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx-9*scale),Math.round(top+18*scale),18*scale,2*scale);
   ctx.fillStyle=hair;ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx-10*scale),Math.round(top+5*scale),5*scale,8*scale);
  }else if(n.id==='father'||n.id==='karenFather'){
   ctx.fillStyle=dark;ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx-13*scale),Math.round(top+19*scale),5*scale,5*scale);
   ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx+8*scale),Math.round(top+19*scale),5*scale,5*scale);
  }else if(n.id==='caretaker'||n.id==='karenMother'){
   ctx.fillStyle=accent;ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx-6*scale),Math.round(top+28*scale),12*scale,3*scale);
   ctx.fillStyle=skin;ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx-3*scale),Math.round(top+27*scale),6*scale,3*scale);
  }else if(n.id==='mika'||n.id==='orphan'||n.id==='theo'){
   ctx.fillStyle=hair;ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx-9*scale),Math.round(top+4*scale),4*scale,7*scale);
   ctx.fillStyle=accent;ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx-6*scale),Math.round(top+23*scale),12*scale,2*scale);
  }else if(n.id==='baker'){
   ctx.fillStyle=accent;ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx-6*scale),Math.round(top+26*scale),12*scale,8*scale);
   ctx.fillStyle=shade;ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx-4*scale),Math.round(top+30*scale),8*scale,2*scale);
  }else if(n.id==='farmer'){
   ctx.fillStyle=shade;ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx-9*scale),Math.round(top+30*scale),18*scale,4*scale);
   ctx.fillStyle=accent;ctx.fillRect(Math.round(cx-7*scale),Math.round(top+29*scale),14*scale,2*scale);
  }
  ctx.restore();CapitalEnvironment.npcAccent(ctx,state.map,n);AshFrontierEnvironment.npcAccent(ctx,state.map,n);OpeningWorldLife.villager(ctx,state.map,n,Date.now());
  return false
}
function drawNpc(n){const close=Math.abs(state.x-n.x)+Math.abs(state.y-n.y)<=2,face=close?facingBetween([n.x,n.y],[state.x,state.y],'down'):(['fieldWorker','brookKeeper'].includes(n.id)?'left':'down');
 const authored=drawNpcCommercial(n,face);
 // Hand props are already baked into the authored resident sheets.
 // The former workplace overlay repainted rectangles over their hands/face.
 if(!authored)OpeningWorldLife.workplace(ctx,state.map,n,Math.abs(state.x-n.x)+Math.abs(state.y-n.y)<=5?Date.now():0);
 if(close){ctx.font='bold 9px system-ui';const w=Math.max(28,ctx.measureText(n.name).width+8);const px=n.x*TILE+16-w/2;
 const atlas=typeof OpeningPixelAssets!=='undefined'&&OpeningPixelAssets.featuredStatus?.();
 const tall=authored&&atlas?.ready&&atlas.artVersion!=='classic-v1'&&OpeningPixelAssets.featuredNames?.includes(n.id);
 // The previous name tag was painted ON the NPC's forehead when approached.
 // Place it ABOVE the actual head instead; ordinary 32px characters remain
 // closer to ground and need a lower tag. Do not resize any actual portrait.
 const py=n.y*TILE-(tall?28:15);ctx.fillStyle='rgba(13,16,20,.88)';ctx.fillRect(px,py,w,13);ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(210,181,112,.28)';ctx.strokeRect(px+.5,py+.5,w-1,12);ctx.fillStyle='#efe6d2';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText(n.name,n.x*TILE+16,py+10);ctx.textAlign='start'}}

function front(){let x=state.x,y=state.y;if(state.dir==='up')y--;if(state.dir==='down')y++;if(state.dir==='left')x--;if(state.dir==='right')x++;return{x,y}}
function visibleObject(o){return !objectCleared(o.id)}
function drawInteractionMarker(){const f=front(),m=maps[state.map];let target=m.npcs.find(n=>npcVisible(n)&&n.x===f.x&&n.y===f.y);if(!target)target=m.objects.find(o=>o.x===f.x&&o.y===f.y&&visibleObject(o));if(!target&&state.map==='village'&&f.y===0&&[11,12].includes(f.x))target={x:f.x,y:f.y};if(!target)return;const cx=target.x*TILE+16,cy=Math.max(12,target.y*TILE+2);ctx.fillStyle='#f1d077';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(cx,cy);ctx.lineTo(cx+5,cy+5);ctx.lineTo(cx,cy+10);ctx.lineTo(cx-5,cy+5);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.55)';ctx.stroke()}
function currentQuestTarget(){const candidate=GC.CommercialDiscovery?.questHint?.(state.map);if(candidate)return candidate;
 if(state.map==='capital'&&!getWorldSwitch('returnedKingdom')){
  if(!isEventComplete('alpha.capital.ceremony'))return{id:'capitalOfficial',kind:'npc'};
  if(!isEventComplete('alpha.capital.whiteStagNight'))return{id:'capitalInnDoor',kind:'object'};
  if(!isEventComplete('warBriefing'))return{id:'granz',kind:'npc'};
 }
 if(state.map==='capitalinn'&&isEventComplete('alpha.capital.ceremony')&&!isEventComplete('alpha.capital.whiteStagNight'))return{id:'innRest',kind:'object'};
 if(state.map==='frontier'){
  if(!isEventComplete('alpha2.frontier.briefing'))return{id:'frontierOfficer',kind:'npc'};
  if(!isEventComplete('alpha2.frontier.hospital'))return{id:'frontierMedic',kind:'npc'};
  if(!isEventComplete('alpha2.frontier.vanguardVictory'))return{id:'vanguardCaptain',kind:'npc'};
  if(!isEventComplete('alpha2.frontier.complete'))return{id:'frontierOfficer',kind:'npc'};
  if(!isEventComplete('alpha2.frontier2.order'))return{id:'frontierOfficer',kind:'npc'};
  if(!isEventComplete('alpha2.frontier2.aftermath'))return{id:'frontierMedic',kind:'npc'};
  if(isEventComplete('alpha2.frontier2.scavengerVictory')&&!isEventComplete('alpha2.frontier2.complete'))return{id:'frontierOfficer',kind:'npc'};
 }
 if(state.map==='frontierfield'){
  if(!isEventComplete('alpha2.frontier2.fieldBriefing'))return{id:'frontierScout',kind:'npc'};
  if(!isEventComplete('alpha2.frontier2.tracks'))return{id:'stretcherTracks',kind:'object'};
  if(!isEventComplete('alpha2.frontier2.satchel'))return{id:'imperialSatchel',kind:'object'};
  if(!isEventComplete('alpha2.frontier2.orders'))return{id:'withdrawalOrders',kind:'object'};
  if(!isEventComplete('alpha2.frontier2.discovery'))return{id:'woundedImperial',kind:'npc'};
 }
 if(state.map==='borderland'){
  if(!isEventComplete('borderBriefed'))return{id:'borderScout',kind:'npc'};
  if(!isEventComplete('borderMerchantAsked')&&!isEventComplete('borderMerchantHelped'))return{id:'lostMerchant',kind:'npc'};
  if(isEventComplete('borderMerchantAsked')&&!getWorldSwitch('borderSparePin'))return{id:'oldCheckpoint',kind:'object'};
  if(getWorldSwitch('borderSparePin')&&!isEventComplete('borderMerchantHelped'))return{id:'lostMerchant',kind:'npc'};
  if(isEventComplete('borderMerchantHelped')&&!isEventComplete('borderRested'))return{id:'relayHost',kind:'npc'};
 }
 if(state.map==='watchfort'){
  if(!isEventComplete('fortBriefed'))return{id:'fortCommander',kind:'npc'};
  if(!isEventComplete('fortMapSeen'))return{id:'fortMap',kind:'object'};
  if(!getWorldSwitch('fortGateOpen'))return{id:'fortCommander',kind:'npc'};
  if(!isEventComplete('metKlein'))return{id:'klein',kind:'npc'};
 }
 return null
}
function drawQuestMarker(){const q=currentQuestTarget();if(!q)return;const m=maps[state.map],item=q.kind==='npc'?m.npcs.find(n=>n.id===q.id&&npcVisible(n)):m.objects.find(o=>o.id===q.id&&visibleObject(o));if(!item)return;const px=item.x*TILE+16,py=item.y*TILE-8;ctx.fillStyle='rgba(26,20,11,.78)';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(px,py,8,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();ctx.fillStyle='#f2cf67';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(px,py-6);ctx.lineTo(px+5,py);ctx.lineTo(px,py+6);ctx.lineTo(px-5,py);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();ctx.strokeStyle='#fff0ad';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.stroke()}
